Itgezar, bekadmita la hava yada ella deinnun bene nasha, ulevatar yada deinnun malachin kaddishin veatu bishlichuta legabbeh. beshaata deamru leh ayye sara ishtecha uvisru leh besorat yitzchak.

Elav atvavn nekudot ayyo, vesiman ayyo, remez lema dilela, remez lekudesha berich hu. vayyomer hinne vaohel. ketiv hacha hinne vaohel uchetiv hatam (Yeshayahu 33:20) ohel bal yitzan vegomer. ta chaze, kevan denakud 17 ammay ketiv levatar ayye, ella begin dechibbura didchar venukeva kechada raza dimhemnuta. keden amar vayyomer hinne vaohel. tamman hu kishshura decholla vetamman ishtakkach (vayyomer hinne beohel). ayye vegomer, vechi la havu yade malache illae desara hinne vaohel, ammay ketiv ayye. ella la yade behay alma ella ma deitmasar lehu leminda.

Ta chaze (Shemot 12:12) veavarti beeretz mitzrayim ani Adonai. vechi kamma shelichin umalachin it leh lekudesha berich hu, ella begin deinnun la yade ben tippa devuchera lehahu dela buchera bar kudesha berich hu bilchodoy.

Kegavvna da (Yechezkel 9:4) vehitveta tav al mitzchot haanashim. veammay tzerichin. ella begin deinnun la yade, ela ma deitmasar lon leminda (yade), kegon kol innun millin dezammin kudesha berich hu leayytaa al alma. umay tama begin dekudesha berich hu aavar karoza bechulhu rekiin behahi milla dezammin leaytaa al alma.
Vayyikkach aharon vegomer vayyaamod ben hammetim vegomer. vchen avdu vitbatal minnayyhu.

Shamu hahu kala deamar sitra sitra kammayyta ochilu leela deha dina dishmaya la ashre hacha deha yade levatla leh. chalash libbeh derabbi acha, idmuch, shama deamre leh, kad avadt da avid da, zil vema lon deyachzerun bitshuva dechayyayvin innun kammay. kam vachazar lehu bitshuva shelemata, vekabbilu alayyhu dela yitbatlun (94 1 0) meorayyta lealam, veachalifu shema dekarta vkarun lah mata machseya.

Amar rabbi yehuda lo day lahem latztzaddikim shemvatlin et haggezira ella leachar ken shemvarchin lahem, teda lach shekken hu, dechevan shehanneshama omeret lagguf mahari shelosh seim vegomer vechol oto hainyan umevatel et haddin, ma ketiv vayyomer shov ashuv elecha keet chayya hare beracha.

Kevan sheroim otah hammalachim shezze lakach etztza lenafsho, ma osim, holchim etztzel harshaim leayyen bedinam velaasot bahem mishpat hada hu dichtiv vayyakumu mishsham haanashim vayyashkifu al peni sedom limkom harshaim laasot bahem mishpat.
Hada hu deamar rabbi yehuda kach darko shel tzaddik kevan sheroe shemayynin bedino eno mitacher lashuv ulehitpalel ulehakriv (al) chelbo vedamo lifne tzuro ad shemmistallekin baale haddin mimmennu.
202: Bealma bae bar nash leitkasya beveteh vela yitchaze beshuka begin dela yitchabbel, kema deat amer, (Shemot 12:22) veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker. minnayyhu (deyachil laasatetarea, en, aval mikkamme kudesha behach hu lo 1) bae leistattera. ma ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 23:24) im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai.

Ayye sara ishtecha, dela vau lomar kammah, kevan deamar hinne vaohel miyyad vayyomer shov ashuv elecha keet chayya vehinne ven lesara ishtecha vegomer. ta chaze, orach ara, dead la azmin avraham kammayyhu lemechal la amru leh midde, begin dela yitchaze divgin hahi besora ka azmin lehu lemechal, batar dichtiv vayychelu keden amru leh hahi besora.

Vayyochelu, salka datach vechi malache illae achle, ella begin yekara deavraham itchaze hachi. amar rabbi elazar vayyochelu vadday, begin deinnun (104 1) esha deachil esha vela itchaze, vechol ma deyahav lon avraham achle begin demissitra deavraham achle leela (deachle mehahu sitra dilella).

Ta chaze, kol ma deachil avraham betohora ihu ka achil uvegin kach akriv kammayyhu veachle, venatir avraham beveteh dachya umesaavuta, deafillu bar nash deihu mesaav (lo yachil lekarva leveteh keden yada avraham deha mesaav ihu veavid) (nusach acher lo hava meshammesh beveteh, ad deavid) leh tevila, o avid leh lenatra shiva yomin kedka chaze leh beveteh, vehachi hu vadday.
Ta chaze ketiv, (Devarim 23:11) ish asher lo yihye tahor mikre layla vegomer. may takanteh, vehaya lifnot erev yirchatz bammayim. iara beh tuma

Vayyar vhinne shelosha anashim nitztzavim alav, ma ketiv banneshama, vaymaher avraham haohela el sara. bechippazon uvimhirut belo shum haekava, miyyad memaheret hanneshama etztzel hagguf lehachaziro lemutav ulevakkesh bamme sheyyitkapper lo ad shemmistallekin mimmennu baale haddin.

Rabbi eliezer omer mahu deamar vavraham vesara zekenim baim bayyamim chadal lihyot lesara orach kannashim. ella kevan shehanneshama omedet bemaalatah vehagguf nishar baaretz mikkamma shanim, baim bayyamim, shanim veyamim harebe. vechadal latztzet velavo velaavor orach kishar kol adam, itbassar lehachayot hagguf.
Mahu omer achare veloti hayta li edna, achare veloti beafar mehayyom kamma shanim hayta li edna vechiddush, vadoni zaken shehayyom kamma shanim sheyyatztzat mimmenni velo hifkidani.
Vekudesha berich hu amar hayippale meAdonai davar lammoed. mahu lammoed. oto hayyadua etztzeli lehachayot hammetim. ulesara ven melammed sheyyitchaddesh keven shalosh shanim.

Amar rabbi yehuda berabbi simon kevan shehanneshama nizonet mizzivah shel mala, kudesha berich hu omer leoto hammalach hannikra 55, lech uvasser leguf peloni sheani atid lehachayoto lammoed sheani achayye et hatztzaddikim leatid lavo. vhu meshiv achare veloti hayta li edna. achare veloti beafar vshachanti baadama veachal besari rimma vegush afar tihye li chiddush.

203: Ochora kegon ziva o (nusach acher segiru o nidda) segirat nidda dehavu teri mesaavu, la sagya leh behahi tevila (begin) ben deiara beh keri kodem dekabbil tuma ochora (begin) ben deiara beh levatar.

Veavraham vesara havu metakkene tevila lechulhu, ihu legavre veihi lenashshe. may tama iasak avraham ledakkaa livni nasha, begin deihu tahor veikre tahor. dichtiv, (Iyov 14:4) mi yitten tahor mittame lo echad. tahor da avraham denafak mitterach.

Rabbi shimon amar begin letakkana hahu darga deavraham, uman ihu mayim. vegin kach atkin ledakkaa beni alma bemaya. uveshaata deazmin lammalachin, sheruta demilloy ma ketiv yukach na meat mayim. begin leittakkefa behahu darga demayin sharan bah.

Uvegine chach hava medakke lechol bene nasha mikkolla. medakke lon missitra deavoda zara, umedakke lon missitra dimsoova, vechamma deihu medakke leguverin hachi name sara medakkat lenashin, veishtakkachu kulhu deatyayn legabbayyhu dachyayn mikkolla.

Ta chaze, ilana nata avraham bechol atar dediyyureh tamman, vela hava salik bechol atar kedka yeut, bar beshaata dediureh beara dichnaan, uvehahu ilana hava yada man deitachid be bekudesha berich hu uman deitachid beavoda zara.

Man deitachid bekudesha berich hu, ilana hava paris anpoy vechafe al resheh veavid aleh tzilla yae, uman deitachid besitra deavoda zara hahu ilana hava istallak veanpoy havu selikin leela. keden hava yada avraham veazhir leh, vela aade mittamman ad deitachid bimhemnuta dekudesha berich hu,
Vehachi man deihu dachya (davar acher 33 hachi) mekabbel leh ilana. man deihu mesaav la mekabbel leh. keden yada avraham umedakke lon bemaya.

Umaayayna demaya hava techot hahu ilana, uman detzarich tevila miyyad mayin salkin legabbeh, veilana istallekin anpoy, keden yada avraham deihu mesaava uvae tevila miyyad, veim lav maya negivan keden yada devae leistoova uleistamra shiva yomin.

Ta chaze, deafillu beshaata deazmin lon lemmalachin amar lon vehishshaanu tachat haetz begin lemechome ulemivdak behu, uvehahu ilana hava badik lechol bene alma. veraza (lekabbel) begin kudesha berich hu ka (eved) amar deihu ilana dechayye lecholla, uvegin kach vehishshaanu tachat haetz velo tachat avoda zara.

Veta chaze, kad chav adam, beetz haddaat tov vara chav, dichtiv umeetz haddaat vegomer veihu beh chav vegaram mota lealma. ma ketiv veatta pen yishlach yado velakach gam meetz hachayyim vegomer. Vayyomer shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya. amar rabbi yitzchak shov ashuv, shov yashuv mibbae leh, deha maftecha da lemifkad akarot bida dekudesha berich hu ihu vela bida dishlicha ochora.

Kema detaninan telat maftechan innun dela itmesaru bida dishlicha. dechayya utechiyyat hammetim ugeshamim. vehoil dela itmesaru bida dishlicha ammay ketiv shov ashuv. ella vadday kudesha berich hu dehava kaim alayyhu amar (leh) milla, vegin kach ketiv vayyomer shov ashuv elecha.

Veta chaze, bechol atar dichtiv vayyomer setam o vayyikra setam hu malacha divrit vela ochora. vayyomer dichtiv, (Shemot 15:26) vayyomer im shamoa tishma vegomer vayyomer vela kaamar man hu. vayyikra dichtiv, (Vayikra 1:1) vayyikra el moshe vela kaamar man hava. amar dichtiv, (Shemot 24:16) veel moshe amar vegomer vela amar man hava. 204: Hava) ella bechol hanne malacha divrit hava vecholla bekudesha berich hu ittemar. uvegin kach ketiv vayyomer shov ashuv elecha vegomer. vehinne ven vegomer:

Vehinne ven lesara ishtecha. may tama la ketiv vehinne ven lecha, ella begin dela yachashov deha min hagar ihu kidvekadmita. rabbi shimon patach veamar, (Malachi 1:6) ben yechabbed av veeved adonav. ben yechabbed av da yitzchak leavraham.

Ematay kabbid leh, beshaata deakad leh al gabbe madbecha uvea lemikrav leh karbana, veyitzchak bar telatin usheva shenin hava, veavraham hava sava, deilu hava bait (sefer acher beh) beragla chad la yachil lemekam kameh, (kol shekken lemebad leh), veihu okir leh leavoy veakad leh kechad imra begin lemebad reuteh deavoy.

(146 2) Veeved adonav da eliezri leavraham. kad shaddar leh lecharan, veavad kol reuteh deavraham, veokir leh kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:1) vaAdonai berach et adoni vegomer. uchetiv (Bereshit 24:34) vayyomer eved avraham anochi, begin leokir leh leavraham.

Deha bar nash dehava mayyte kesef vezahav veavne yekar ugemallin veihu kedka yeut shappir bechezu la amar deihu rechima deavraham o kariva dileh. ella amar eved avraham anochi, begin lesalleka beshivcha deavraham uleokir leh beenayyhu.

Veal da ben yechabbed av veeved adonav. veattun yisrael banay. kelana beenayychu lomar deana avuchon o deattun avadin li. veim av ani ayye chevodi vegomer. vegin kach vehinne ven, da hu ben vadday, vela yishmael. da hu ben deokir leavoy kedka chaze.

Vehinne ven lesara ishtecha. ben lesara, divgineh mitat, divgineh keivat nafshah ad denafkat minah. vehinni ven lesara. leistallaka begineh beshaata dekudesha berich hu yativ bedina al alma. dichden vaAdonai pakad et sara vegomer deha madkere lesara beginih deyitzchak veal da ihu ben lesara (anehav Malachi amro). vehinne ven lesara. (din) deha nukeva natla (leh) livra min dechura:

Vesara shomaat petach haohel vehu acharav. may vehu acharav, vehi acharav mibbae leh. ella raza ihu, vesara shomaat ma dehava amar (patach haohel da kudesha berich hu. vehu acharav man dehava amar) petach haohel da darga tattaa. pitcha dimhemnuta. vehu acharav (da) deode leh darga illaa (nusach acher patach haohel vehu acharav da kudesha behach hu. patach haohel da darga tattaa, vehu acharav da darga illaa). min yoma dehavat sara bealma la shamat milla dekudesha berich hu bar hahu shaata.
Davar acher dehavat yatva sara petach haohel begin lemishma millin. vehi shamat hay milla deitbassar bah avraham. (davar acher) vehu acharav. avraham dehava yativ achoroy dishchinta:

Veavraham vesara zekenim baim bayyamim. may baim bayyamim. shiurin deyomin deitchaze keden lehu, chad mea vechad tishim, alu beyomin shiura deyomin kedka yaot. baim bayyamim. kema deat amer ki va hayyom deiarav yoma lemeal.
Chadal lihyot lesara orach kannashim. vehahi shaata chamat garmah beidduna ochora. uvegin kach amra vaadoni zaken deha ihu la cheday leolada begin deihu sava.

Rabbi yehuda patach (Mishlei 31:23) noda bashshearim baalah beshivto im zikne aretz. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu istallak bikareh deihu ganiz vesatim beiluya sagya. lav itay bealma vela hava min yoma deitbere alma deyachil lekayyma al chachmata dileh vela yachil lekayyma beh.

Begin deihu ganiz vesatim veistallak leela leela, vechulhu illae vetattae la yachlin leitdabbeka, ad dechulhu amrin (Yechezkel 3:12) baruch kevod Adonai mimkomo. tattae amre deihu leela dichtiv, (Tehillim 113:4) al hashshamayim kevodo. ilae amre deihu letatta dichtiv, (Tehillim 57:6) al kol haaretz kevodecha. ad dechulhu illae vetattae amre baruch kevod Adonai mimkomo. begin dela ityeyda vela hava man deyachil lekayyma beh, veat amart noda bashshearim baalah.
205: Ella vadday noda bashshearim balah da kudesha berich hu deihu ityeda veitdabbak lefum ma dimshaer belibbeh kol chad kamma deyachil leiddabbeka berucha dechachmeta. ulefum ma dimshaer belibbeh hachi ityeda belibbeh. uvegini chach noda bashshearim beinnun shearim. aval deityeda kedka yeut la hava man deyachil leiddabbeka uleminda leh.

Rabbi shimon amar noda bashshearim baalah. man shearim. kema deat amer (Tehillim 24:7) seu shearim rashechem vehinnasu pitche olam. uvegin ellu shearim deinnun dargin illain beginayyhu ityeda kudesha berich hu. vei la la yachlin leitdabbaka beh.

Ta chaze, deha nishmata debar nash lav ihu (nusach acher lo it) man deyachil leminda lah, ella begin illen shayyfin degufa veinnun dargin deavdin umanuta denishmata vegin kach ityeda vela ityeda. kach kudesha berich hu ityeda vela ityeda begin deihu nishmata lenishmata rucha lerucha ganiz vetamir mikkolla, aval beinnun shearim deinnun pitchin lenishmata ityeda kudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, it pitcha lefitcha vedarga ledarga, uminnayyhu yedia yekara dekudesha berich hu. petach haohel, da hu pitcha detzedek. kema deat amer (tehillim 118) pitchu li shaare tzedek vegomer da pitcha kadmaa leoola beh, uvehay pitcha itchazzun kol shear pitchin illain. man dezache lehay (pitcha) zache leminda beh uvechulho shear pitchin begin dechulhu sharan aleh.

Vehasheta defitcha da la ityeda. begin deyisrael begaluta vechulhu pitchin istallaku minneh vela yachlin leminda uleitdabbeka. aval bezimna deyifkun yisrael min galuta zeminin kulhu dargin illain lemishre aleh kedka yeut.

Ucheden yindeun beni alma chachmeta illaa yakkira ma dela havu yadin mikkadmat dena. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 11:2) venacha alav ruach Adonai ruach chachma uvina ruach etza ugevura ruach daat veyirat Adonai. kulhu zeminin leashraa al hay pitcha tattaa deihu petach haohel. vechulhu zeminin leashraa al malka meshicha begin lemedan alma dichtiv veshafat betzedek dallim vegomer.

Begine chach kad itbassar avraham, hay darga hava amar kema deittemar dichtiv vayyomer shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya. vayyomer, la ketiv man hava. veda hu petach haohel. veal da vesara shomaat hay darga dehava mallil immeh man dela hava shemaat mikkadmat dena. dichtiv vesara shomaat petach haohel dehava mevasser veamar shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya vehinne ven lesara ishtecha.

Ta chaze, kamma hu chavivuta dekudesha berich hu legabbeh deavraham, deha la nafak minneh yitzchak ad deitgezar, levatar deitgezar itbassar beh beyitzchak, begin deihu keden zara kaddisha, vead la itgezar lav ihu zara kaddisha. ucheden ihu kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:12) asher zaro vo leminehu.

Veta chaze, ad la itgezar avraham hahu zara dileh la hava kaddisha, begin denafak bego arla veitdevak bearla letatta. levatar deitgezar nafak hahu zara bego kaddisha, veitdevak bikdusha dilela veolid leela, veitdevak avraham bedargeh kedka yeut. ta chaze, kad olid avraham leyitzchak nafak kaddisha kedka yeut. vehay (nusach acher vadday) may aadu veolidu chashocha.
Rabbi elazar shail yoma chad lerabbi shimon avoy, amar leh hay dekara leh kudesha berich hu yitzchak dichtiv vekarat et shemo yitzchak. ammay, deha itchaze dead la nafak lealma kara leh yitzchak.

Amar leh ha ittemar deesha natal maya. deha maya missitra digvura ka atyayn. vetu (nusach acher veta shail lehu lelevae) (shail leh) levae deinnun bedichin lehahu sitra bemane zemer vetushbechan lokovel hay sitra, vegin kach yitzchak ihu chedva begin deate mehahu sitra veitdabbak beh.
Ta chaze, yitzchak bedichuta chedva deachlaf maya beesha veesha bemaya, veal da ikre hachi. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu kare leh
206: Hachi ad la yippuk lealma shema da veoda leh leavraham.

Veta chaze, bechulhu ochoranin shavak lon kudesha berich hu lemikre lon shemahan, veafillu nashe havu karan livnayyhu shemahan, aval hacha la shavak kudesha berich hu leimmeh lemikre leh shema ella leavraham, dichtiv vekarata et shemo yitzchak ant vela ochora, begin leachlafa mayya beesha veesha bemaya leachlala leh besitreh.

Kevan deitbassar avraham beyitzchak, ma ketiv vayyakumu mishsham haanashim vayyashkifu al peni sedom. rabbi elazar amar ta chaze, kamma anhag kudesha berich hu tivu im kol beriyayn vechol shekken leinnun deazle bearchoy, deafillu bezimna devae lemedan alma, ihu garim leman derachim leh lemizke bemilla ad la yete hahu dina lealma.

Detaninan beshaata dekudesha berich hu rachim leh lebar nash, meshadder leh dorona, uman ihu, missekena, begin deyizke beh. vechevan dezache beh, ihu amshich aleh chad chuta dechesed deitmeshach missetar yamina ufaris aresheh verashim leh, begin dechad yete dina lealma hahu mechabbela yizdehar beh, vezakef enoy vechama lehahu reshimu ucheden istallak minneh veizdehar beh. begine chach akdim leh kudesha berich hu bemma deyizke.

Veta chaze, kad bae kudesha berich hu leaytaa dina al sedom, azke kodem leavraham veshaddar leh dorona lemizke immehon begin leshezava lelot bar achuha mittamman, hada hu dichtiv vayyizkor elohim et avraham vayshallach et lot mittoch hahafecha. vela ketiv vayyizkor elohim et lot, deha bizchuteh deavraham ishteziv. umay vayyizkor, dedachir leh may deazke kodem im innun telat malachin.

Kegavvna da bar nash deyizke bitzdaka im bene nesha, beshaata dedina sharya bealma kudesha berich hu adkar leh lehahi tzedaka deavad. begin debchol shaata dezache bar nash hachi achtiv aleh leela, veafillu beshaata dedina sharya aloy kudesha berich hu idkar leh lehahu tivu deavad vezacha im bene nasha. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 11:4) utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet. begine chach akdim leh kudesha berich hu leavraham begin deyizke visheziv lelot.

Vayyashkifu al pene sedom. ta chaze, vayyakumu mishsham haanashim. mehahi seuda deatkin lo avraham vezacha behu. af al gav demalachin havu, zacha behu, vechol hahu mechla la ishtaar minneh kelum, begine deavraham, ulemizke beh, deha ketiv vayyochelu beesha dilhon (120 1) itachil.

Vei tema ha telat malachin havu. hay esha. vehay maya. vehay rucha. ela kol chad vechad kalil bechavreh uvegine chach vayyochelu. kegavvna da (Shemot 24:11) vayyechezu et haelohim vayyochlu vayyishtu. achila vaddait achlu deitzanu min shechinta, uf hacha vayyochelu garmu (nusach acher nirmaz ramaz) leitzena (minneh) mehahu sitra deavraham itdevak beh, uvegin kach la asharu mimma deyahiv lon avraham kelum.

Kegavvevna da bae leh lebar nash lemishte mehahu kassa divracha, begin deyizke lehahi beracha dilela. uf innun achlu mimma deatkin lon avraham begin deyizkun leitzena missitra deavraham. deha mehahu sitra nafik mezona lechulhu malache illae.
Vayyashkifu, itaruta derachame leshezava lelot. ketiv hacha vayyashkifu uchetiv hatam (Devarim 26:15) hashekifa mimmeon kadshecha. ma lehallan lerachame uf hacha lerachame.

Veavraham holech immam leshallecham. lemebad lon levaya. amar rabbi yesa i tema deavraham yada demalachin innun ammay aavid lon levaya. ella amar rabbi elazar af al gav dehava yada (ragil hava lameaked lechullehu bene nasha dizminin immeh lameaked lon leviyya) (nusach acher ma dehava ragil lemebad im bene nasha eved behu vaalavey lon) begin dechach itzterich leh lebar nash lemebad levaya leushepizin deha kolla behay talya,
Uveod deihu hava azil immehon itgeli kudesha berich hu aleh deavraham dichtiv vaAdonai amar hamechasse ani meavraham asher ani ose. vaAdonai hu uvet dineh, begin dekudesha berich hu hava azil
207: Ta chaze kad bar nash avid levaya (levar nash) lechavreh ihu amshich (aleh) lishchinta leitchabbera bahadeh ulemehach immeh bearcha leshezava leh. uvegin kach bae leh lebar nash lelavuye leushepiza begin dechabbar leh lishchinta veamshich aleh leitchabbera bahadeh.

Vegin kach vaAdonai amar hamechasse ani meavraham asher ani ose. rabbi chiyyay patach (Amos 3:7) ki lo yaase Adonai elohim davar ki im gala sodo el avadav hanneviim. zakkain innun zakkae alma dekudesha berich hu itrae behu, bechol ma deihu avid barkia vezammin lemebad bealma, al yede dezakkain avid leh, vela kasse minnayyhu lealmin kelum.

Begin dekudesha berich hu bae leshattafa bahadeh (letzadikaya dela tehe pitchon pe lerashiayyay bechol ma deihu avid. ta chaze, kolla galle kudesha berich hu) letzaddikaya begin deinnun atyayn umazhirin livne nasha leatava mechovayyhu vela yitanshun miggo dina illaa vela yehe lon pitcha defuma legabbeh. begine chach kudesha berich hu oda lon raza deihu avid behu dina. tu begin dela yemrun deha bela dina avid behu dina.

Amar rabbi elazar vavy lon lechayyayvaya dela yadin vela mashgichin vela yadin leistammera mechovayyhu. uma kudesha berich hu di kol ovadohi keshot veorchateh din. la avid kol ma deavid bealma ad degale lehu letzaddikayay begin dela yehe lon pitcha defuma livne nasha. (kan shayych ma shebbesof hassefer siman 18, 80 lekamman daf 106 amud alef vatematzeanev sham) gabbe bene nasha lo chol shekken deit lon lemebad millayyhu dela yemallelun bene nasha sitya alehon. vechen ketiv, (Bamidbar 32:22) vihyitem nekiyyim meAdonai umiyyisrael.

Veit lon lemebad dela yehe lon pitchon pe livne nasha, veyitrun behon i innun chatan vela mashgeche leistammara, dela yehe leh lemiddat dina dekudesha berich hu pitcha defuma legabbayyhu. uvemma, bitshuva veovadin dechashran.
Ta chaze, vaAdonai amar hamechasse ani meavraham. amar rabbi yehuda, kudesha berich hu yahav kol ara leavraham
VaAdonai amar hamechasse ani meavraham vegomer ma ketiv lemala vayyakumu mishsham haanashim vayyashkifu al peni sedom laasot din barshaim. ma ketiv acharav hamechasse ani meavraham.

Amar rav chasda en hakkadosh baruch hu ose din barshaim ad shennimlach benishmatan shel tzaddikim hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 4:9) minnishmat eloah yovedu. uchetiv hamechasse ani meavraham. amar hakkadosh baruch hu kelum yesh li laasot din barshaim ad sheemalech benishmot hatztzaddikim, veomer lahem, harshaim chatu lefanay, eese bahem din, dichtiv vayyomer Adonai zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba vchatatam vegomer.

Amar rabbi avhu hanneshama omedet bimkomah vehi yerea lehitkarev elav velomar lefanav kelum, ad sheyyomar lemttrvn sheyyaggishenna lefanav vetomar ma sheratztzeta, hada hu dichtiv vyyiggash avraham, vayyomer haaf tispe tzaddik im rasha chalila lecha vegomer.

Ulay yesh chamishshim tzaddikim vegomer. hanneshama potachat veomeret ribbono shel olam shemma nitasseku ben parashiyyot shel tora, veaf al pi shelo nitasseku lishmah, sachar yish lahem laolam habba velo yikkansu laggehinnom. ma ketiv batreh vayyomer Adonai im emtztza bisdom chamishshim tzaddikim vegomer.

Vha (tanenan) yattir innun parashiyyot 53 havu. ella amar rabbi abbahu chamishsha sefarim hem battora uvechol echad veechad nichlalim aseret haddibberot asara maamarot shebbahem nivra haolam chashov asara bechol chad minnehon hu chamishshim.

Od potachat hanneshama veomeret ribbono shel olam af al pi shelo nitasseku battora shemma kibbelu onsham al ma shechatu bebet din venitkapper lahem shenneemar (Devarim 25:3) arbaim yakkennu lo yosif. umimma shennitbayyshu lifnehem dayyaym lehitkapper (lifnehem) lahem shello yikkansu laggehinnom. ma ketiv acharav lo eese baavur haarbaim.

Od potachat vomeret ulay yish sham sheloshim, ulay yish benehem tzaddikim shehissigu sheloshim maalot harmuzim bappasuk (Yechezkel 1:1) vayhi bishloshim shana vehem kelulim belv netivot shehem 22 otiyyot 16 sefirot lifamim hem kelulim lishmona.
Od potachat vomeret ulay yimmatztzeun sham esrim, shemma yegaddelu banim letalmud tora vyish lahem sachar laaseret haddibberot shete peamim bechol yom, deamar rabbi yitztzechak
208: Lemeheve leh achsanat yeruta lealmin, dichtiv ki et kol haaretz asher atta roe lecha ettenenna vegomer. uchetiv sa na enecha uree. ulevatar kudesha berich hu itzterich leaakara atrin illen. amar kudesha berich hu, kevar yahavit yat ara leavraham, vehu abba lecholla, dichtiv ki av hamon goyim netatticha. vela yaot li lemimche benin vela oda laavuhon dekarit leh avraham ohavi. uvegin kach itzterich leoda leh, vegin kach (amar) vaAdonai amar hamechasse ani meavraham asher ani ose.

Amar rabbi abba ta chaze (111 1) invetanuta deavraham, deaf al gav deamar leh kudesha berich hu zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba. veim kol da deorich immeh veoda leh devae lemebad dina bisdom, la baa kameh leshezava leh lelot vela yaavid beh dina. may tama begin dela lemitba agra min ovadoy.
Veal da shalach kudesha berich hu lelot vesheziv leh begineh deavraham. dichtiv vayyizkor elohim et avraham vayshallach et lot mittoch hahafecha vegomer.

May asher yashav bahen lot ha ittemar. aval begin dechulhu chayyayvin vela ishtechach (benayyhu), mikkulhu deit leh midi dizchu, bar lot. mikkan olifna bechol atar dedayyrin beh chayyayvin chariv ihu.
Asher yashav bahen lot. (108 1) vechi bechulhu hava yativ lot, ela begineh havu yatve dela itcharvu. vei tema bizchuteh, la. ella bizchuteh deavraham.
Amar rabbi shimon ta chaze, deshimmusha deavid bar nash lezakkaa, hahu shimmusha agin aleh bealma. vela od ella deaf al gav deihu chayyayva, olif mearchoy veavid lon.

Ta chaze deha begin deitchabbar lot bahadeh deavraham af al gav dela olif kol ovadoy, olif lemebad tivu im biryayn kema dehava avid avraham, veda hu deotiv lechol innun karte kol hahu zimna deyatvu batar deal lot benayyhu.

Amar rabbi shimon ta chaze, dishchinta la aade minneh deavraham behahi shaata dekudesha berich hu amar leh (behahu zimna dekudesha berich hu immeh), amar leh rabbi elazar veha shechinta hava mallil immeh deha (bedarga) da itgeli aleh kudesha berich hu dichtiv, (Shemot 6:3) vaera el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov beel shadday. amar leh hachi hu vadday.
Veta chaze ma ketiv vayyomer Adonai zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba. bekadmita vaAdonai amar. ulevassof vayyomer Adonai zaakat sedom vaamora vegomer. da ihu darga illaa deitgele leh al darga tattaa,
Kol hamegaddel beno letalmud tora umolicho levet rabbo babboker uvaerev maale alav hakkatuv keillu kiyyem (alav) hattora 2 peamim bechol yom. ma ketiv vayyomer lo ashchit baavur haesrim.

Od potachat veomeret ulay yimmatztzeun sham asara. omeret ribbono shel olam shema hayu meotam haasara harishonim shel bet hakkeneset shennotel sachar keneged kullam shebbaim acharehem, ma ketiv (beh) vayyomer lo ashchit baavur haasara.

Kol ze yish lenishmat hatztzaddik lomar al harshaim, kevan shello nimtztza beyadam kelum, ma ketiv vayyelech Adonai kaasher killa ledabber el avraham veavraham shav limkomo. mahu limkomo. limkom maalato hayedua.

Amar rabbi mitztzeva lo laadam lehitpallel al harshaim kede sheyyachzeru lemutav velo yikkansu laggehinnom. dichtiv, (Tehillim 35:13) vaani bachalotam levushi sak vegomer. vamar rabbi asur lo laadam lehitpallel al harshaim sheyyistalleku min haolam, sheilmale silleko hakkadosh baruch hu leterach min haolam keshehaya oved avoda zara, lo ba avraham avinu laolam, veshivte yisrael lo hayu, vehammelech david umelech hammashiach, vehattora lo nittena, vechol otam hatztzaddikim vehachasidim vhanneviim lo hayu baolam. amar rabbi yehuda kevan sheroe hakkadosh baruch hu shelo nimtztza barshaim kelum mikkol otam hainyaynim, ma ketiv vyyavou sheni hammalachim sedoma vegomer, (74 kan midrash hannelam)
209: Erda na veere hakketzaakatah habbaa elay asu kala. leman kaamar. i tema leinnun malachin. man chama mallil im da ufakkid leda. ella leavraham kaamar devirshuteh kayymin innun atre. davar acher leinnun malachin.

Ma deittemar leavraham ma taama asu. asa mibbae leh. may asu. (ella) da avraham ushechinta dela aade minneh. (davar achar) asu ma deittemar lammalachin, begin dehavu zeminin tamman vehavu mishtakkechin lemebad dina, veal da asu.

Davar acher asu (lemebad) ketargumo avdu. vechi la hava yada kudesha berich hu deihu amar erda na veere, veha kolla itgeli kammeh. ella erda na middarga derachame ledarga dedina, vehayeynu (hay) yerida. veere, reiyyay da hi leashgacha alehon beman dina yadin lon.

Ashkechan reiyyay letav veashkechan reiyyay levish. reiyyay letav, dichtiv, (Shemot 2:25) vayyar elohim et beni yisrael vayyeda. reiyyay levish, dichtiv erda na veere (nusach acher ashkechan yerida letav veashkechan yerida levish. letav dichtiv, 1 vayyered Adonai al har sinay. 2 veyaradti vedibbarti immach sham. yerida levish erda na begin) leashgacha alayyhu bedina, veal da amar kudesha berich hu hamechasse ani meavraham:

Veavraham hayo yihye legoy gadol veatzum. may tama beracha da hacha. ela begin leodaa deafillu beshaata dekudesha berich hu yativ bedina al alma la ishtanni. deha yativ bedina al da (davar acher 33 vitev) uverachame al da vecholla beriga chada uveshaata chada.

Amar rabbi yehuda veha ketiv, (Tehillim 69:14) vaani tefillati lecha Adonai et ratzon. zimnin deihu et ratzon vezimnin delav ihu et ratzon. zimnin deshama vezimnin dela shama. zimnin deishtechach vezimnin dela ishtechach dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 55:6) dirshu Adonai behimmatzo kerauhu bihyoto karov.

Amar rabbi elazar kan leyachid kan letzibbur. kan leatar chad vechan lechule alma. begini chach barich leh leavraham deihu shakil kechol alma dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram (uchetiv) vetaninan beavraham.
Yihye begimatriyya sheloshim. hachi taninan telatin tzaddikim azmin kudesha berich hu bechol dara vedara lealma. kema deazmin leavraham.

Patach veamar, (Shmuel 2 23:23) min hashsheloshim hachi nichbad veel hashshelosha lo va vegomer. min hashsheloshim hachi nichbad, illen innun telatin tzaddikim deazmin kudesha berich hu lealma vela yevattel lon minneh. uvenayahu ben yehoyada ketiv beh min hashsheloshim hachi nichbad ihu chad minnayyhu. veel hashshelosha la va. dela shakil litlata ochoranin dealma kaim alayyhu.

Veel hashshelosha lo va. lemehve beminyayna kechad minnayyhu. beinnun telatin zakkain zacha lemeal bechushebna, aval veel hashshelosha lo va, dela zacha leitchabbera behu ulemeheve immehon bechulaka chada. yihye, kema detaninan telatin hava. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu barcheh beinnun telatin tzaddikim.

Ta chaze, amar leh kudesha berich hu leavraham zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba, deha selikat kodamay ma deinnun avdin lechol alma, dechol alma mane raglayyhu dela lemeal bisdom vaamora dichtiv, (Iyov 28:4) paratz nachal meim gar hannishkachim minni ragel dallu meenosh nau. paratz nachal meim gar, pirtza hava paritz nachal leinnun bene alma dealu letamman. dechulhu dechaman leman dehavu yahave lemechal ulemishte levar nash ochora, shadyayn leh (benukeve danekarey) beumeka denahara, veihu denatil leh hachi name.

Veal da kulhu bene alma havu nishkachim minni ragel. demane raglayyhu dela lemeal tamman. uman deal, dallu meenosh nau, dehavu dale gufa bechafna la havu yahave leh lemechal ulemishte veishtanne diukeneh mishshear bene alma, dichtiv dallu meenosh, nau. ketiv hacha nau. uchetiv hatam (Mishlei Adonai:6) nau mageloteha. hachi name havu satan maagalin vearchin dela lemeal tamman. veafillu ofe shemaya havu mane
210: Lemeal tamman dichtiv, (Iyov 28:7) netiv lo yedao ayit vegomer. uvegine chach kulle alma havu tzavvchin al sedom veal amora veal kulhu karte. dechulhu kegavvna chada havu.

Zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba. amar leh avraham. ammay. amar leh vechattatam ki chavda meod. begine chach erda na veere, hakketzaakatah. hakketzaakatam mibbae leh, deha ketiv zaakat sedom vaamora utere karte havu, ammay hakketzaakatah. ella ha ukemuha.

Ta chaze, besitra detute kala devarda salkin kutere kulhu bechattefa mitkanshe bechad tif vealin bego nukeve dithoma rabba, itavidu chamesh bechad. chad ihu kad (tzelilan kalin) ikka tzelilin kalin dechulhu itavidu chad. kala desalik mittatta al benayyhu veitmashchu kechad.
Vehahu kala salka venachata tava dina leitmashcha letatta. kad hay kala salka lemitba dina keden itgeli leashgacha kudesha berich hu bedina.

Amar rabbi shimon, hakketzaakatah. man hakketzaakatah, da gezerat dina detava dina kol yoma. dehachi taninan kamma shenin kayyma gezerat dina vetava mikkamme kudesha berich hu al dezabbinu achuy deyosef leyosef. begin digzerat dina tzavvchat al dina, veal da hakketzaakatah, habbaa elay.
May (107 1) habbaa elay. da hu raza kema deat amer, (Ester 2:14) baerev hi vaa uvabboker hi shava. veda hu habbaa elay tadir. kegavvna da ketz kol basar ba lefanay veha ittemar. asu kala ha ittemar:

Vayyigash avraham vayyomar haaf tispe tzaddik im rasha. amar rabbi yehuda man chama abba derachmanuta keavraham. ta chaze, benoach ketiv vayyomer elohim lenoach ketz kol basar ba lefanay vegomer ase lecha tevat atze gofer. veishtik vela amar leh midi. vela vaa rachame. aval avraham beshaata deamar le kudesha berich hu, zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba vegomer. erada na veere vegomer. miyyad ketiv vayyiggash avraham vayyomar haaf tispe tzaddik im rasha.

Amar rabbi elazar, uf avraham la avad shelimu kedka yeut. noach la avid midi, la hay vela hay. avraham tava dina kedka yeut dela yemut zakkaa im chayyayva. veshare mechamishshim ad asara, avad vela ashlim, dela baa rachame ben kach uven kach, deamar avraham la baina lemitba agar ovadoy.

Aval man avad shelimu kedka yeut, da moshe. dechevan deamar kudesha berich hu (Shemot 32:8) saru maher min hadderech vegomer. asu lahem egel massecha vayyishtachavu lo. miyyad ma ketiv vaychal moshe et pene Adonai elohav vegomer. ad deamar veatta im tissa chattatam veim ayin mecheni na missifrecha asher katavta. veaf al gav dechulhu chatu, la zaz mittamman ad deamar leh salachti kidvarecha.
Aval avraham la ashgach ella i ishtechach behu zakkay veim lav la. veal da la hava bealma bar nash deyagin al dareh kemoshe deihu raaya mehemna.
Vayyiggash avraham vayyomar, atkin garmeh lemitba da. ulay yimmatzu sham chamishshim. shara mechamishshim deihu sheruta leminda, ad asara deihu asiraa sofa dechol dargin.

Amar rabbi yitzchak ad asara, illen asara yomin deven rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim. begin kach shara mechamishshim ad asara. vechevan demata laasara, amar mikkan uletatta lav hu atar dekayyma bitshuva, begine chach la nachat letatta measara:
Vayyavou shene hammalachim sedoma baerev vegomer. amar rabbi yose ta chaze ma ketiv leela vayyelech Adonai kaasher

Midrash hanneelam rabbi patach behay kera (Shoftim 3:1) veelle haggoyim asher hinniach Adonai lenassot bam et yisrael. amar rabbi chaze havit behahu alma (velet alma) kaim (davar acher velet maale) ella beinnun
211: Killa ledabber el avraham. deha kevan deitperash shechinta meavraham, veavraham tav leatreh, keden vayyavou shene hammalachim sedoma baerev, deha chad istallak bishchinta, veishtaaru innun teren.
Kevan dechama lot lon, rahat batrayyhu. may tama, vechi kol innun dehavu atyayn ihu ail lon leveteh veyahiv lon lemechal ulemishte uveni mata hech la katlin leh, deha livratteh avdu dina.
Umay hu. divratteh delot yahavat pitta denahama lechad anya, yadu bah, shafuha duvesha veotvuha berish igra ad deachluha tzire.
Ella begin dehava belelya chashiv dela yistakkelun leh bene mata, veim kol da kevan daaalu leveta itkenashu kulhu veascharu leveta.

Amar rabbi yitzchak ammay rahat lot abbatrayyhu, (ella begin) dichtiv vayyar lot vayyaratz likratam. rabbi chizkiyya verabbi yesa. chad amar diukena deavraham chama imhon. vechad amar shechinta atya alayyhu. ketiv hacha vayyar lot vayyaratz likratam, uchetiv hatam vayyaratz likratam mippetach haohel. ma lehallan chama shechinta, uf hacha chama shechinta.

Vayyar lot vayyaratz likratam vayyomer hinne na adonay beAlef dalet nun yod. suru na, geshu na mibbae leh, may suru na. ella leahadara lon sacharaneh deveta begin dela yechomun lon bene mata, vela yealun beorach meshar leveta, uvegin kach suru na.

Rabbi chizkiyya patach (Iyov 28:24) ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit tachat kol hashshamayim yire. kamma it lon livne nasha leistakkala beovadoy dekudesha berich hu, uleishtaddala beorayyta yemama velele, dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta, kudesha berich hu ishtabbach beh leela, veishtabbach beh letatta, begin deorayyta ilana dechayye ihi lechol innun deaskin bah lemehav lon chayyin bealma den

Deshallitin al reuta delibbehon shenneemar (Tehillim 81:6) edut bihosef samo vegomer. amar rav yehuda lamma zacha yosef leotah hammaala vehammalchut, bishvil shekkavash yitztzero. detaninan kol hakkovesh et yitztzero malchuta dishmaya achil aleh.

Deamar rav acha lo bara hakkadosh baruch hu layyetztzer hara ella lenassot bo bene adam. umi bae kudesha berich hu lenassuta bivne nasha. in. deamar rav acha mena lan middichtiv, (Devarim 13:4) ki yakum bekirbecha navi vegomer uva haot vehammofet vegomer ki menase Adonai elohechem vegomer. velama bae nasuta deha kol ovadoy devar nash itgeli kammeh, ella shelo latet pitchon pe livne adam. ree ma ketiv velot yoshev beshaar sedom, dehava yativ lenassuta livriyyayta.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak may dichtiv (Yeshayahu 57:20) veharshaim kayyam nigrash vegomer. afillu bishat dino shel rasha hu meiz panav vazay hu berishato kayyaym, ree ma ketiv terem yishkavu vegomer. amar rabbi yitztzechak keshem shebbara kudesha berich hu gan eden baaretz kach bara gehinnom baaretz. ucheshem shebbara gan eden lemala kach bara gehinnom lemala.

Gan eden baaretz dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:8) vayyita Adonai elohim gan beeden vegomer. gehinnom baaretz dichtiv, (Iyov 10:22) eretz efata kemo ofel vegomer. gan eden lemala dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 25:29) vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitztzeror hachayyim et Adonai elohecha uchetiv, (Kohelet 12:7) veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah.
Gehinnom lemala dichtiv veet nefesh oyvecha yekalleenna betoch kaf hakkala. gan eden lemata kidkaamaran. gan eden lemala lenishmatan shel tzaddikim gemurim lihyot nizzonin meor haggadol shel mala.

Gehinnom lemata leotam harshaim (deyisrael) shello kibbelu berit mila velo heeminu behakkadosh baruch hu vedato vlo shamru shabbat, veellu hem ovde kochavim umazzalot shenniddonim baesh, shenneemar (Yechezkel 15:7) mehaesh yatztzau vehaesh tochlem vegomer. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 66:24) veyatztzeu verau befigre haanashim vegomer.

Gehinnom lemala leotam poshe yisrael sheavru al mitztzevot hattora velo chazru bitshuva sheddochim otam lachutz ad sheykabbelu ansham. veholchim vesovvim kol haolam shenneemar (Tehillim 12:9) saviv reshaim yithallachun.
Vesham niddonim shenem asar chodesh, leachar ken madoram im otam shekkibbelu ansham bemotam
212: Ta chaze, ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit. lemehav lon mezona ulesappaka lon mikkol ma deitzterichu, begin deihu ashgach bah tadir, dichtiv, (Devarim 11:12) tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah merishit hashshana vead acharit shana.

Begin deeretz da ma ketiv bah (Mishlei 31:14) mimmerchak tavi lachmah, ulevatar ihi yehavt mezona vetarfa lechol innun chevan bera dichtiv (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha.

Veal da ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit tachat kol hashshamayim yire. lechulhu bene alma lemehav lon mezona vesippuka lechol ma deitzterich kol chad vechad dichtiv (Tehillim 145:16) poteach et yadecha umasbia lechol chay ratzon.
Davar acher ki hu liktzot haaretz yabbit. leistakkala ovadoy devar nash uleashgacha bechol ma deavde bene nasha bealma. tachat kol hashshamayim yire. mistakkel vechame lechol chad vechad.

Ta chaze, kevan dechama kudesha berich hu ovadin disdom vaamora, shaddar lon leinnun malachin lechabbala lisdom. ma ketiv vayyar lot chama lishchinta. vechi man yachil lemechome shechinta, ela chama zahara chad denahir deka salka al reshayyhu. ucheden vayyomer hinne na adonay beAlef dalet kema deittemar, uvegin shechinta hahu nehiru denahir kaamar, suru na el bet avdechem velinu verachatzu raglechem.

La avad hachi avraham, ella bekadmita amar verachatzu raglechem ulevatar veekcha pat lechem vegomer. aval lot amar suru na el bet avdechem velinu. ulevatar verachatzu raglechem vehishkamtem vahalachtem ledarkechem. begin dela yishtemodun behu bene nasha.
Vayyomru lo ki varchov nalin. begin dechach havu avde orchin dealin tamman la hava bar nash deyichnosh lon leveta, veal da amru lo ki varchov nalin. ma ketiv vayyiftzar bam meod vegomer.

Ta chaze kad kudesha berich hu avid dina bealma, shelicha chada avid leh, vehasheta chamenan tere sheluche, ammay vechi la sagge bechad. ela chad hava, uma deamar tere (hachi hu vadday begin dechad) chad hava leappaka leh lelot uleshezava leh, vechad lemehpach lekarta ulechabbala ara, uvegin kach ishtaar chad:
Kol echad vechad kefi hammakom harauy lo. veharshaim shel haovde kochavim umazzalot niddonim tamid baesh uvammayim veshuv enam olim shenneemar veishsham lo tichbe.

Mishpat harshaim baggehinnam kema dichtiv vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora gafrit vaesh vegomer vshuv enam olim vlo yakumu leyom haddin shenneemar (Devarim 29:22) asher hafach Adonai beappo uvachamato, beappo baolam hazze. uvachamato baolam habba.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak lehay gavvna it gan eden lemala veit gan eden lemata. it gehinnom lemata vit gehinnom lemala. amar rabbi yaakov harshaim shekkilkelu berit mila shebbahem vechillelu shabbat befarhesya vechillelu et hammoadot veshekkafru battora veshekkafru bitchiyyat hammetim vechaddome lahem yordim laggehinnom shellemata veniddonim sham veshuv enam olim.

Aval yakumu leyom haddin veyakumu litchiyyat hammetim, vaalehem neemar (Daniel 12:2) verabbim misheni admat afar yakitztzu elle lechayye olam vegomer. vaalehem neemar (Yeshayahu 66:24) vehayu deraon lechol basar. ma deraon, dayy raon, shehakkol yomru dayy biriyyaytam. veal hatztzaddikim shebbeyisrael neemar (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim vegomer, (ad kan midrash hannelam)

VaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora vegomer. rabbi chiyyay patach (Yeshayahu 13:9) hinne yom Adonai ba achzari vegomer. hinni yom Adonai ba, da be dina letatta. ba kema deittemar. (106 1) habbaa elay (asu). begin dela avid dina ad deal venatil reshu, kegavvna da ketz kol basar ba lefanay.
Davar acher hinne yom Adonai ba. da hu mechabbela letatta kad natil nishmata, begine kach achzari veevra. lasum haaretz leshamma, da sedom vaamora. vechattaeha
213: Ma ketiv batreh ki kochve hashshamayim uchesilehem vegomer. deha min shemaya amtar alehon esha, veaavar lon min alma. levatar ma ketiv okir enosh mippaz vegomer. da avraham dekudesha berich hu salik leh al kol bene alma.

Rabbi yehuda okim lon lehanne kerae beyoma deitcharav be makdesha, divhahu yoma itchashchu illae vetattae, veitchashchan shemaya vechochvaya. rabbi elazar mokim lehanne kerae beyoma deyokim kudesha berich hu lichneset yisrael meafra, vehahu yoma yityeda leela vetatta, dichtiv, (Zecharya 14:7) vehaya yom echad hu yivvada laAdonai. vehahu yoma yoma denokma ihu, dezammin kudesha berich hu lenakma mishshear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot.

Vechad kudesha berich hu yaavid nukemin bishar amin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, keden okir enosh mippaz da malka meshicha deyistallak veyityaykar al kol beni alma, vechol bene alma yiflechun veyisgedun kammeh dichtiv, (Tehillim 72:9) lefanav yichreu tziyyim vegomer malche tarshish vegomer.

Ta chaze, af al gav dinvua da ittemar al bavel, becholla ittemar. deha chamenan behay parshata dichtiv (230 samuch 110 shellemala 320 bah okir enosh vegomer veulay ladaat 123 chad 280 hi) ki yerachem Adonai et yaakov. uchetiv ulekachum ammim vehevium el mekomam.

VaAdonai himtir al sedom. da darga deve dina letatta denatil reshu meela. rabbi yitzchak amar deavid dina berachame. dichtiv meet Adonai min hashshamayim. begin leishtakkacha dina berachame. vei tema may rachame hacha dichtiv vayhi beshachet elohim et are hakkikkar vayyizkor elohim et avraham vegomer. ulevatar nafku minneh teren umin shelemin, vezacha denafik minneh david ushelomo malka.

Chame ma ketiv vayhi kehotziam otam hachutza vayyomer vegomer. ta chaze (63 1) beshaata dedina share bealma, ha ittemar dela libbae lebar nash leishtakkacha beshuka, begin dechevan desharya dina la ashgach ben zakkaa vechayyayva, vela vae (leistakkela) leishtakkacha tamman. veha ittemar divgin kach istim noach batteva vela yishgach bealma beshaata dedina yitavid. uchetiv (Shemot 12:22) veattem lo tetzu ish mippetach beto ad boker ad deyitavid dina. uvegin kach vayyomer himmalet al nafshecha al tabbit acharecha vegomer.

Rabbi yitzchak verabbi yehuda havu azle bearcha. amar rabbi yehuda lerabbi yitzchak dina deavid kudesha berich hu bammabbul vedina disdom, tarvavyyhu dinin degehinnom havu begin dechayyayve gehinnom itdanu bemaya uveesha.

Amar rabbi yitzchak sedom bedina degehinnom itdan, dichtiv vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora gafrit vaesh meet Adonai min hashshamayim. da missitra demayay veda (ayyen sof hassefer siman 2) missitra deesha. da veda hu dina degehinnom, vechayyayvin degehinnom bitren dinin illen itdanu.

Amar leh dina dechayyayve degehinnom teresar yarche, vekudesha berich hu salik lon miggehinnom, vetamman mitlabbenin veyatvin letara degehinnom, vechaman innun chayyayvin dealin vedanin lon tamman, veinnun tave rachame alayyhu. ulevatar kudesha berich hu chayyis alayyhu veail lon leducheta deitzterich lon. mehahu yoma ulehala gufa ishtechach beafra venishmata yarta

Sitre tora toseppeta keture rammay, huremne (ayyen sof hassefer 70 2) divdure. (nusach acher dabevareyrey 57 dabevareyynay) chakkimin besuchletanu, yistakkelun leminda, beshaatta deresha chivvavra attekin kurseyay al gabbe samchin deavnin demargelitan tavan.
Ben innun avnin itt chad margalita shappira bechezu yaa bereva kumetra dekantara (nusach acher dakeyteraa) dimlahata be gevavnin, innun 70 gevavnin melahatan lechol setar.

Illen 70 mitteparshan miggo 3 gevavnin. illen zikin bezikin dintztzitztzin led sitre alma, hacha itta zika takkippa distar semala deitteachid bishmaya. innun gevavnin shivin (Daniel 7:10) dina yattiv vesipperin petichu.
Mehacha nappeke girin useyaypin veromchin veesha dekusetra. veitteachid esha takkippa denappeka mishamayim beh, vechad itteachad eshsha illaa beillen diltatta, lett man deyachil leittebar rugeza
214: Ta chaze deha ittemar deafillu innun bene tofana la itdanu ella beesha umayya. mayyay keriran nachate milleela, umayyay retichan salke mittatta keesha. veitdanu bitre dinin, begin dedina dilela hachi hava, vegin kach bisdom gafrit vaesh.

Amar leh i yekumun leyom dina. amar leh ha ittemar. aval illen disdom vaamora la yekumun, ukera ochach dichtiv, (Devarim 29:22) gafrit vamelach serefa chol artzah lo tizzara velo tatzmiach vegomer. asher hafach Adonai beappo uvachamato. asher hafach Adonai, bealma den. beappo, bealma deate. uvachamato, bezimna dezammin kudesha berich hu laachayay metayyay. amar leh ta chaze, kamma deara dilhon itavid lealam ulealme almaya, hachi name itavidu innun lealam ulealme almaya.
Veta chaze, dina dekudesha berich hu dina lokovel dina. innun la hava tayyvin nafsha demiskena bemechla uvemishtayya, uf hachi kudesha berich hu la ativ lon nafshayyhu lealma deate.

Veta chaze, innun itmenau mitztzedaka deikre chayyim, uf kudesha berich hu mana minnayyhu chayyim bealma den uvealma deate. vechamma deinnun manu archin ushevilin mibbene alma, hachi name kudesha berich hu mana minnayyhu orchin ushevilin derachame lerachama alayyhu bealma den uvealma deate.

Rabbi abba amar kulhu bene alma yekumun, vikumun ledina vealayyhu ketiv, (Daniel 12:2) veelle lacharafot ulederaon olam. vekudesha berich hu mari derachamin ihu, kevan dedan lehu behay alma vekabbilu dina, la itdanu bechulhu dinin.

Amar rabbi chiyyay ketiv vayshallach et lot mittoch hahafecha vegomer. (105 1) mahu bahafoch et hearim asher yashav bahen lot. ela bechulhu avad diyyureh lot, dichtiv velot yashav beare hakkikkar vayyeehal ad sedom. Ayynin lahatin ketisin denura, nachitt behu lealma. vavy man deiara beh, chagir chartztzin (sefer acher charevin), ihu charba shinnena bideh, la chayis al tav veal bish. deha (sefer acher paska) pitteka deinnun shivin birshu deitteachid hahu sitra dishmaya nachitt bida semala bechamma dinin,

Ittehappecha bechamma gevavnin, happucha bechol yoma, ihu ikre kerum zellutt dimtakkena legabbe bene adam. kol gevavnin dichle zaamo dekudesha bericha hu beh ittechazzeyayn. veinnun yattevin berume dealma, uvene nasha besichlutta dilhon la mashgeche behon.

216: Da deikkere shamayim minneh ittebre sittera deikkere adam. chashvan shayype guppa deinnun chusheban mattan vearbein uttemanya shayypin.

Chashvan attevohi mattan veshitt sare, shema da deihu raza vesittera kelala dechol orayyta bechv attevavn veeser amiran, begin deha shema da mattan veshitt sare attevavn uttelattin utteren shevilin deitteklilan beh, ha mattan vearbain uttemanya shayypin deguppa

Raza deikre adam deshallit al kurseyay. raza deshivin diltatta, vesittera da dichtiv (Yechezkel 1:26) veal demutt hakkisse demutt kemare adam alav millemala, veda hu sittera dichtiv vaAdonai himtir al sedom vegomer meett Adonai min hashamayim. vecholla chad umilla chada, vesittera chada lachachime libba ittemasar, zakkaa (davar acher 33 ihu) chulakhon bealma den uvealma deatte.

Sedom gezar dina dilhon al demanu tzedaka minnayyhu, kema deat amer, (Yechezkel 16:49) veyad ani veevyon lo hechezika. uvegin kacha dina la hava ella min shamayim. tzedaka veshamayim kolla chad uchetiv, (Tehillim 108:5) ki gadol meal shamayim chasdecha, uvegin detalya tzedaka bishmeh (nusach acher besamim) dina hu mishamayim dichtiv mott Adonai min hashamayim.

Dina deyisrael mehay attar dichtiv, (Eicha 4:6) vayyigdal avon batt ammi mechatatt sedom. veikre yerushalem achott lisdom kema deat amer, (Yechezkel 16:49) hinne ze haya avon sedom achottecha, vedinhon hava min shemaya dina chada kisdom al demanu tzedaka minnayyhu. bar deda ittehappacha veda ittecharav, da itt lah tekuma, veda lett lah tekuma, (ad kan sitre tora).

Vattabbet ishto meacharav, meachareha mibbae leh, ella mibbatar shechinta. rabbi yose amar mibbatrih delot, dimchabbela azil avatreh, vechi avatrih azil, veha hu shaddar leh, ella bechol atar dehava azil lot itakkav mechabbela lechabbala, vechol atar deazil kevar veshavik laachoreh hava mehappech leh mechabbela.

Uvegin kach amar leh al tabbet acharecha deha ana achabbel batrach, veal da ketiv vattabbet ishto meacharav vechamat mechabbela. keden vattehi netziv melach. deha bechol zimna dimchabbela la chame anpoy devar nash (nusach acher achme anpe lakkar nash) la mechabbil leh. kevan deitteteh ahadderat anpaha leistakkala avatrih miyyad vattehi nitztzav melach.

Rabbi elazar verabbi yose havu kayyme yoma chad veaske behay kera, amar rabbi elazar ketiv, (Devarim 8:9) eretz asher lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem, lo techsar kol bah. hay bah bah teri zimne ammay. ella ha ittemar dekudesha berich hu palig kol ammin vearan limmannan shelichan, veara deyisrael la shallit bah malacha vela memanna ochora ella ihu bilchodoy, begin kach ail leamma dela shallit behu ochora leara dela shalit bah ochora.

Ta chaze, kudesha berich hu yahiv mezona tamman bekadmita ulevatar lechol alma. kol shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot bemiskenut, veara deyisrael lav hachi, ella eretz yisrael ittezan bekadmita ulevatar kol alma.

Uvegin kach eretz asher lo vemiskenut tochal bah lechem. ella beatiru besippuka decholla tochal bah vela beatar ochora. bah bikdishu deara, bah sharya mehemnuta illaa. bah sharya birketa dilela, vela beatar ochora.

Ta chaze ketiv kegan Adonai keeretz mitzrayim. ad hacha la ityeda gan Adonai i hu eretz mitzrayim, vei ihu eretz sedom, (daf kat amud alef) vei ihu gan Adonai deikre gan eden. ella kegan Adonai deit beh sippuka veidduna decholla, hachi name hava sedom vehachi name mitzrayim. ma gan Adonai la itzterich bar nash leashkaa leh, uf mitzrayim la itzterich ochora leashkaa leh, begin denilus ihu assik veashke lechol ara demitzrayim.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Zecharya 14:17) vehaya asher lo yaale meet mishpechot haaretz el yerushalem vegomer. da hu onasha dilhon deitmena minnehon mitra, ma ketiv veim mishpachat mitzrayim lo taale velo vaa vegomer. chame dela ketiv velo alehem yihye haggeshem, begin dela nachit mitra lemitzrayim vela itztarchan leh, ella onasha dilhon ma hu dichtiv, (Zecharya 14:12) vezot tihye hammaggefa asher yiggof Adonai et kol haggoyim vegomer. begin demitzrayim la tzerichin lemitra. uf sedom ma ketiv beh ki chullah mashke, kol iddunin dealma havu vah, veal da la vaan divne nasha ochoranin yitaddenun bah.

Rabbi chiyyay amar innun havu chayyayvin miggarmayyhu umimmamonhon, dechol bar nash deihu tzar ena legabbe miskena, yaot hu dela yitkayyaym bealma. velo od ella delet leh chayyim lealma deate. vechol man deihu vavtran legabbe miskena yaot hu deyitkayyaym bealma, veyitkayyaym alma begineh, veit leh chayyim veorka dechayye lealma deate:
Vayyaal lot mitztzoar vayyeshev bahar hu ushete venotav immo vegomer. may tama. begin dechama dehava kariv lisdom veistallak mittamman.

Rabbi yitzchak patach (Iyov 37:12) vehu mesibbot mithappech betachbulotav lefoolam vegomer. kudesha berich hu mesabbev sibbuvin dealma veayyte kumerin tehirin lemebad ovadoy, ulevatar mehappech lon veavid lon kegavvna ochora.
Uvemma, betachbulotav, avid tachbulin umesabbev sibbuvin laafacha lon velav keinnun kadmae.

Midrash hanneelam vayyaal lot mitztzoar vegomer. amar rabbi abbahu, bo uree ma ketiv bayyetztzer hara, teda lecha sheeno mitbatel leolam mibbene adam ad oto zeman dichtiv, (Yechezkel 36:26) vahasiroti et lev haeven vegomer. sheaf al pi sheroe bene adam niddonin baggehinnam, hu ba vechozer lo etztzel bene adam, hada hu dichtiv vayyaal lot mitztzoar. mitztzaarah shel gehinnom mishsham ole lefattot bene adam.

217: Lefoolam, begin poolam divne nasha, kema deinnun avdin ovadin hachi mehappech lon. kol asher yetzavvem al pene tevel artza. begin deovadin divne nasha mehappech leinnun mesibbot bechol ma deihu pakkid lon al peni tevel vegomer.

Rabbi elazar amar vehu mesibbot mithappech. hakkadosh baruch hu mesabbev sibbuvin veayyte ovadin bealma leitkayyma, ulevatar dechashivu bene nasha deyitkayymun innun ovadin, kudesha berich hu mehappech lon leinnun ovadin mikkema dehavu bekadmita.

Betachbulotav. betachbulato ketiv kehay omana deavid manin decharsa. beod dehahi tikla istacharat kameh. chashiv lemebad kegavvna da avid. chashiv lemebad kegavvna ochora avid. mehappech mana da lemana da, begin dehahu tikla istacharat kammeh. kach kudesha berich hu mehappech ovadoy deihu avid.
Betachbulotav chaser yod, uman ihu, da be dina letatta deihu tikla deistacharat kammeh, veal da mehappech manin mimmana da lemana ochora.

Vechol da kefi poolam divne nasha, i metivin bene nasha ovadehon, hahu tikla desachara ascharat lon leyamina, ucheden itavidu ovadin bealma leotava lon kedka yeut. vetikla ascharat tadir vela shachich behahu sitra deyamina vealma mitgalgela beh.

Koach hanneshama hakkedosha. vehanehagat hattaava shehi mitavva bechol taavot raot, vzehu koach hattaava. vehahanhaga hamanheget livne adam umechazzeket hagguf vehi nikret nefesh hagguf, amar rav dimi zehu koach hammachazik.

Amar rabbi yehuda bo uree leolam en yetztzer hara sholet ella beellu 2 kochot illen deamaran, nefesh hammitavva hi harodefet achar yitztzer hara leolam, mashma dichtiv vattomer habbechira el hatztzeira avinu zaken. nefesh hammitavva hi meoreret et haacheret umefatta otah im hagguf lehiddavek bayyetztzer hara, vhi omeret lecha nashke et avinu yayin venishkeva immo. ma yish lanu baolam habba, nelech venirdof achar yitztzer hara veachar teshukat chemdat haolam hazze. uma osot, shetehen maskimot lehiddavek bo, ma ketiv vattashkena et avihen yayin mitpatmot lehitorer leyyitztzer hara baachila uvishtiyya.

Vattakam habbechira vattishkav et aviha. kesheadam shochev al mitato ballayla, nefesh hamitavva hi hameoreret layyitztzer hara, umeharheret bo, vhu davek bechol hirhur ra ad shemmitabberet meat (sefer acher mimmennu) (davar acher 33 al) (nusach acher ad) shemmevi belev haadam otah hammachashava haraa udeveka bo, vaadayin yish belibbo velo nigmar laasotah ad shezzot hattaava meoreret lechoach hagguf kemittechilla lehiddavek bayyetztzer hara vaz hu tashlum haraa, hada hu dichtiv vattaharena shete benot lot

218: Tachbulato deaschar tadir vehava kayyma beascharuta deyamina, kudesha berich hu aschar leh besitra dismala umehappech mesibbot umanin dehavu bekadmita lehahu setar semala.

Ucheden tikla aschara veitavidu ovadin bealma leavasha lon livne nasha. vetikla aschar lehahu sitra ad divne nasha tayyvin leotava ovadehon. vetikla kayyma beovadin divne nasha. veal da betachbulato lefoolam, vela kayyma tadir.

Ta chaze, lot nafku minneh umibbenateh terin umin mitparshan, veitkesharu behahu sitra deitchaze lon, veal da kudesha berich hu mesabbev

Amar rabbi yitztzechak meolam en yitztzer hara mitpatte ella baachila ushetiyya, umittoch simchat hayyayin az sholet baadam. batztzaddik ma ketiv beh (Mishlei 13:25) tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho. veno mishtakker leolam, deamar rabbi yehuda hay tzureva merabbanan demarvi, karena aleh (Mishlei 11:22) nezm zahav beaf chazir. velo od ella shemchallel shem shamayim. minhag harshaim mahu (Yeshayahu 22:13) hinne sason vesimcha. hayyayin az sholet baadam, harog bakar veshachot tzon vegomer. alehem amar hakkatuv (Mishlei 5) hoy mashkime vabboker shechar yirdofu vegomer. kede leorer layyitztzer hara, sheen yitztzer hara mitorer ella mittoch hayyayin, hada hu dichtiv vattashkena et avihen yayin.

Amar rabbi abbahu ma ketiv velo yada beshichvah uvekumah. kelomar yetztzer hara eno mashgiach bah beshichvah baolam hazze uvekumah laolam habba, ella mitorer im koach hagguf laavod taavato baolam hazze. deamar rabbi abbahu beshaa shennichnasin harshaim baggehinnam machnisim layyetztzer hara lirot bahen, hada hu dichtiv velot ba tzoara letztzaarah shel gehinnom, venafak leh mittamman livriyyayta lenassuta kidkaamaran. hada hu dichtiv vayyaal lot mitztzoar mitztzaarah shel gehinnom.

219: Sibbuvin umegalgel gilgulin bealma deyitavid kolla kedka yeut veyitkashshar kolla beatreh.

Ta chaze, yaot hava lelot dekudesha berich hu yafik minneh (vamebanetayh) umeitteteh terin umin illen, ella begin leitkashshara beatrayyhu deitchaze lehu. veitavidu miggo yena, vehahu yena izdamman lehon bammearta hahi lelya, veda hu raza deitavidu kema deat amer vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishkar veha ittemar veukemuha.

Ta chaze, moav veammon innun karan lon shemahan, moav meav. rabbi yose amar bechira bachatzifu amra moav, meabba hu. vehatztzeira gam hi yalda ben vattikra shemo ben ammi. bitzniu amra ben ammi. bar ammi, vela amra mimman hava.

Ta chaze, bekadmita ketiv vela yada beshichvah uvekumah beVav venakud al vav, begin desiyyua deela hava ishtechach behahu ovada dezammin malka meshicha lenafka minneh, uvegin kach ishtelim hacha beVav. uveochora ketiv uvekummah chaser 22, begin dela nafak minnah chuleka lekudesha berich hu kehay ochora, veal da ketiv behay ochora keshisha uvekumah beVav male venakud alah.

Rabbi shimon amar, la yeda dezammin kudesha berich hu leokma minah david malka ushelomo vechol shear malchin umalka meshicha. tu uvekumah, dichtiv berut (Rut 3:14) vattakam beterm yakkir ish et reehu vegomer. uvehahu yoma hava lah kima vadday

Yare lashevet betztzoar, yira vacharada nofelet alav beshaa sheroe tzaar gehinnom shemtztzaarin larshaim vechoshev sheshsham yiddon, kevan sheroe sheeno niddon sham yotztze veholech lefattot bene adam acharav.
Rav huna kad hava darish leizdahara livne adam, hava amar lehu banay istammaru mishlicha shel gehinnom, uman hu zehu yetztzer hara shehu shaliach shel gehinnom.

Rabbi abba amar may dichtiv, (Mishlei 30:15) laaluka shete vanot hav hav. ellu shete benot lot deamaran, shehi nefesh hammitau, venefesh hammishtattefet bagguf harodefet achar yitztzer hara leolam. amar rabbi yehoshua ketiv hacha belot ki yare lashevet betztzoar, uchetiv hatam laaluka shete vanot hav hav. yare begimatriyya hu aluka. amar rabbi yitztzechak i yare hu lemay ate lemite beriyyayta, ella kach derech kol ose avla, kesheroe hara mityare lefi shaa, miyyad chozer lerishato veno choshesh lichlum, kach yetztzer hara beshaa sheroe din barshaim yare, kevan sheyyotztze lachutz (laasot) eno choshesh kelum.

220: Itchabbar immah boaz lehakim shem hammet al nachalato, veittakam minnah kol hanne malchin vechol illuya deyisrael. velo yada beshichvah dichtiv vattishkav margelotav ad habboker. uvekumah dichtiv vattakam beterem yakkir ish et reehu vegomer. begin kach uvekumah nekud vav.

Ta chaze, (105 amud alef) invetanuta deavraham deha afillu bekadmita kad baa kudesha berich hu lemebad dina bisdom la vaa minneh rachame al lot (deha), levatar dichtiv vayyar vehinne ala kitor haaretz kekitor hakkivshan la tava aleh delot vela amar aleh lekudesha berich hu kelum, uf hachi kudesha berich hu la amar leh midi, begin dela yachasov avraham dekudesha berich hu gara mizchuteh kelum.

Vei tema deavraham la hava chashiv leh lelot belibbeh kelum, ha masar nafsheh lemehach leaggacha kerava bachamishsha melachin takkifin, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 14:14) vayyishma avram ki nishba achiv vegomer. uchetiv vayyechalek alehem layla. uchetiv vayyashev et kol harchush vegam et lot achiv urechusho heshiv vegomer. aval birchimuta dirchim lekudesha berich hu vechama ovadoy delot dela chashran kedka yeut, la vaa avraham divgineh yishbok kudesha berich hu kelum middileh, uvegine chach la tava aleh rachame la bekadmita vela vesofa:

Bo kishar kol harshaim shebbaolam. vish en baaretz lavo alenu, en ish tzaddik baartz, veen ish shallit al yitztzero, harebe reshaim baaretz, let anan bilchodana chayyayvin, naase kederech kol haaretz shehem chayyayvim, shead hayyom derech kol haaretz hu. lecha nashke et avinu yayin, nismach baolam hazze, nochal vnishte venirve chamra venidbak beavinu bayitztzer hara vnishkeva immo. veruach hakkodesh tzoochat veomeret (Yeshayahu 28:7) gam elle bayyayin shagu uvashshechar tau.

Amar rabbi yehuda ta chaze, ma ketiv vtashkena et avihen yayin. derech harshaim litot achare hayyayin lefannek layetztzer hara uleorro, vad shehu sameach beshichruto shochev al mitato, miyyad vattakam habbechira vattishkav et aviha. hi mezmmenet immo umitavva umeharheret bechol hirhurim raim, vyetztzer hara mitchabber immah venidbak bah veno mashgiach bah (sefer acher mehahu zimna) ma hu mimmennah. beshichvah uvekumah. beshichvah baolam hazze uvekumah leatid lavo. beshichvah baolam habba keshettitten din vcheshbon. uvekumah leyom haddin dichtiv, (Daniel 12:2) verabbim miyyeshene admat afar yakitztzu vegomer. beshum inyan meellu en mashgiach bah yitztzer hara, ella davek bah vhi nidbeket bo, uleachar ken meoreret leochora leachar shehahirhur gadol nidbak bayyitztzer hara, baa haacheret venidbeket bo
