221: Avihen yayin. kemo chen leorer layyitztzer hara venidbeket bo vazay tashlum haraot laasot umitabberot shetehen miyyitztzer hara, hada hu dichtiv vattaharen shete venot lot meavehen. ad sheyyatztza lappoal maasehen zo yoledet rishatah vzo yoledet rishatah, vechen darkam shel reshaim beinyan ze im yitztzer hara, ad shehoreg laadam umolicho laggehinnom umachniso sham, veachar kach ole mishsham lefattot livne adam kemo chen. umi shemmakkir bo nitztzol mimmennu veeno mitchabber immo.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak mashal lema haddavar dome, lechat listim shehayu orvim badderachim ligzol velaharog livne adam, umafrishim mehem echad sheyyodea lehasit livne adam uleshono rach, me avid makdim veholech lekabbelam venaasa keeved lifnehem ad shemmaaminim hatippeshim bo uvotchim beahavato uvesichato usemechim immo, umolicham bechelek devarav beoto hadderech shehallistim sham, kevan shemmaggia immahem lesham, hu harishon shehoreg bam, leachar shennotnam beyad hallistim lehargam velakachat mamonam, veinnun tzavvchin veamrin vavy daatztzitna leden velirkicha delishneh. leachar shehargu elle, ole mishsham veyotztze lefattot livne adam kemittechilla. happikchim ma hem osim kesheroim laze yotztze likratam umefatte lahem, makkirin bo shehu tzode et nafsham vehorgim oto veholchim bederech acheret. kach hu yitztzer hara yotztze mikkat hallistim ole miggehinnom lekavla divne nasha ulefattot lahem bechelek metek devarav, hada hu dichtiv vayyaal lot mitztzoar vayyishev bahar vegomer. kemo listim leerov livne adam, ma ose over lifnehem, vehatippeshim maamaynim bo uveahavato shehu holech lefattotam veoved lahem keeved, shennoten lahem nashim yafot asurot, noten lahem bene adam lehara, mefarek mehem ol tora veol malchut shamayim. hatippeshim
Yattir missitra ochora, begin deha bechachmata avad leitdabbeka bedaroma:

Vayyomer avraham el sara ishto achoti hi. taninan (kevan) la libbae leh levar nash lesamcha al nisa, vei kudesha berich hu archish nisa lebar nash, la it leh lesamcha (tadir) al nisa zimna ochora. begin delav bechol shaata veshaata itrechish nisa.

Vei yeul bar nash garmeh beatar denizka ishtechach leena, ha paka kol zechuteh deavad bekadmita veukemuha. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 32:11) katonti mikkol hachasadim umikkol haemet vegomer. veavraham kevan desalik mimmitzrayim veishteziv zimna chada, hasheta ammay ail garmeh betzaara kekadmita veamar achoti hi.

Ella avraham la samich al garmeh kelum, vechama shechinta tadir bediyyurah desara vela aade mittamman, uvegin dehavat tamman, asmich avraham veamar achoti hi kema dichtiv (Mishlei 7:4) emor lachachma achoti att. uvegin kach amar achoti hi (sefer acher et):

Vayyavo elohim el avimelech vegomer. vechi kudesha berich hu ata legabbayyhu derashshiayya kema dichtiv, (Bamidbar 22:9) vayyavo elohim el bilam. (Bereshit 31:24) vayyavo elohim el lavan. ella hahu memanna shelicha deitpakkeda alayyhu hava, begin dechulhu kad avde shelichuta natle shema da, umissitra dedina ka atyayn. veal da vayyavo elohim el avimelech bachalom hallayla vayyomer lo hincha met al haishsha asher lakachta vegomer.
Rabbi shimon patach veamar, (Mishlei 12:19) sefat emet vegomer. sefat emet tikkon laad. da avraham, dechol milloy bekadmita uvesofa havu beemet. vead argia leshon shaker. da avimelech.
Beavraham neemar vayyomer avraham el sara ishto achoti hi. da bekadmita, deamar begin shechinta dehavat immah desara achoti hi, veavraham bechachmeta avad.
222: Roim kach, botchim beahavato, ad sheholech immahem umolicham beoto derech shehallistim sham, bederech gehinnom asher en derech lintot yamin usemol, kevan shemmaggia immahem lesham, hu harishon shehoreg lahem, venaasa lahem malach hammavt umachnisan laggehinnom, umoridin lehon malache chabbala, veinnun tzavvchin veamrin vavy daatztzitna leden, vela mehaneya lon. leachar ken ole mishsham veyotztze lefattot livne adam. happikchin kesheroin oto makkirim oto umitgabberim alav ad sheshsholtin alav, vsatin mizze hadderech velokchin derech acheret lehinnatztzel mimmennu.

Rav yosef kad hava nachit levavel chama innun ravvavkaya dehavu ayyle venafke beni nashshe shappirin vla chatan, amar lon la mistafu illen miyitztzer hara, amru leh la mikkonditon bisha kaatena, mikdushata dekaddisha itgazzarna, deamar rav yehuda amar rav tzarich adam lekaddesh atztzemo bishat tashmish, venafke minnih beni kaddishe beni maale dela mistafu miyetztzer hara shenneemar (Vayikra 20:7) vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim.

Rabbi abba amar may dichtiv, (Yechezkel 20:20) veet shabbetotay kaddeshu, ella en onatan shel talmmidde chachamim ella mishshabbat leshabbat, umazhar lehu dehoil detashmish hammita demitztzeva hu, kaddeshu. kelomar kadshu atztzemchem beshabbetotay behahu tashmish demitztzev. amar rav yehuda amar rav hay man deayil lekarta vechame nashshe shappiran, yarkin enoy veyema hachi, bach (nusach acher sach) safan igzar igzarna (karedaynaa) kardita tekil puk puk deavoy kaddisha deshabbatta hu. may tama dechamimut dearcha shalat beh veyachil yitztzer hara leshalta aloy, (74 kan midrash hannelam)

Begin deavraham missitra deyamina ihu, amar achoti hi, veraza kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:2) achoti raayati yonati tammati. veal da avraham kara lah tadir achoti, begin deitdabbak bahadah, vela yitaddun (Vayikra 102 da min da lealmin).

Lesof ma ketiv vegam amna achoti vat avi hi ach lo vat immi. vechi hachi hava. ella kolla begin shechinta kaamar, achoti hi bekadmita, dichtiv emor lachachma achoti at. ulevatar vegam amna. may vegam. leittosfa al ma dekaamar bekadmita. achoti vat avi hi. beratteh dechachma illaa, uvegin kach itkere achoti veitkere chachma. ach lo vat immi. meatar desheruta decholla setima illaa. veal da vattehi li leishsha beachva bachavivuta dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) vimino techabbekeni vecholla raza dechachmeta ihu.

Ta chaze, bekadmita kad nachtu lemitzrayim hachi kaamar begin leitdabbeka bego mehemnuta, vekara lah achoti, begin dela yitun go innun dargin dilvar. uf hacha achoti, begin dela itade miggo mehemnuta kedka yeut.

Deha avimelech vechol innun yatve ara havu azle batar pulechana nucheraa, veihu itdabbak go mehemnuta, uvegin kach al letamman veamar achoti, ma achot la itperash meacha lealmin uf hacha. deha itteta yechilat leitperasha aval achot la itperash, deha teren achin la yachlin leitparsha lealmin ulealme almin.

Uvegin kach amar avraham achoti hi, deha kulhon havu lehutin go tohore kochvaya umazzale ufalche lon, veavraham hava mitdebak go mehemnuta veamar achoti dela nitperash lealmin. vesimanich (Vayikra 21:3) velaachoto habbetula deittemar lechohen, atra deavraham sharya beh.
Ketiv, (Devarim 10:20-21) et Adonai elohecha tira oto taavod uvo tidbak uvishmo tishshavea. hay kera ukemuha. aval ta chaze, laAdonai elohecha tira la ketiv, ella et
223: Adonai, may et, da darga kadmaa atar dachala dekudesha berich hu, uvegin kach ketiv tira, detamman bae bar nash ledachala kamme mareh (kudesha berich hu) begin deihu (bi) dina.

Veoto taavod. da darga illaa dekayyma al hay darga tattaa, vela mitparshan lealmin, et veoto, da beda devekin vela itparshan. may veoto. da atar berit kaddisha ot lealmin. deha pulechana la sharya beet velav ihu lemiflach ella lemidchal, aval pulechana ihu (115 1) leela, uvegin kach veoto taavod.
Uvo tidbak. beatar deihu devekuta leitdabbeka deihu gufa deshare beemtzaita. uvishmo tishshavea atar sheviaa dedargin. vesimanich (Yirmeyahu 30:9) veet david malkam asher akim lahem.

Begin chach itdabbak avraham bimhemnuta kad nachat lemitzrayim vechad azal leara diflishtim. lebar nash devaa lenachata go guva amika. dachil dela yachil lesalka miggo gova, ma avad kashar chad kishra dechevel leela min gova, amar hoil dekashirna kishra da mikkan ulehala iul tamman. kach avraham beshaata devaa lenachata lemitzrayim. ad la yechut tamman keshar kishra dimhemnuta bekadmita leittakkefa beh, ulevatar nachat.

Uf hachi name kad al leara diflishtim. vegin kach (Mishlei 12:19) sefat emet tikkon laad. vead argia leshon shaker, da avimelech deamar betom levavi uvenikyon kappay. vechad ahadderu leh ma ketiv gam anochi yadati ki betam levavcha asita zot, vela ketiv nikyon kappayim:

Veatta hashev eshet haish ki navi hu. rabbi yehuda patach veamar (Shmuel 1 2:9) ragle chasidav yishmor vegomer. chasido ketiv chad, veda avraham dekudesha berich hu natir leh tadoyr vela aade netiru minneh lealmin. uma deamar ragle, da itteteh, dekudesha berich hu shaddar shechinteh immah venatar lah tadir.

Davar acher ragle chasidav yishmor. chad, da avraham dekudesha berich hu azil immeh tadir begin dela yechlun lenazka leh. ureshaim bachoshech yiddammu. illen innun malchin dakattal kudesha berich hu behahu lelya deradaf batrayyhu.

Hada hu dichtiv bachoshech yiddammu, da lelya deitkashshar bachashocha vekatal lon, veavraham radif velelya katil lon, hada hu dichtiv vayyechalek alehem layla hu vaavadav vayyakkem. vayyechalek alehem layla, da kudesha berich hu defalig rachame min dina begin lemebad nukemin leavraham, uvegin kach ureshaim bachoshech yiddammu. vayyakkem, vayyakkum mibbae leh. ella da kudesha berich hu. ki lo vechoach yigbar ish. deihu veeliezer havu bilchodayyhu.

Rabbi yitzchak amar veha taninan beatar denizka shechiach la yismoch bar nash al nisa, vela hava atar denizkka ishtechach kehay deavraham azil batar chamishsha malchin lemirdaf batrayyhu velaagacha kerava. amar rabbi yehuda kad azil avraham lehay la azal laagacha kerava, vela samach al nisa, ella tzaara delot afkeh mibbeteh, venatil mamona lemifrak leh, vei lav dimut bahadeh go shivyah. kevan denafak chama shechinta denahara kammeh vechamma chelin sochoraneh, behahi shaata radaf batrayyhu, vekudesha berich hu katil lon, hada hu dichtiv ureshaim bachoshech yiddammu.

Rabbi shimon amar raza ihu, ragle chasidav yishmor, da avraham. vechad nafak ishtattaf yitzchak bahadeh venaflu kammeh, vei lav deishtattaf yitzchak bahadeh deavraham la ishtetziu hada hu dichtiv ureshaim bachoshech yiddammu. ki lo vechoach yigbar ish. af al gav dechela ishtechach tadir beyamina, i la hava besitra dismala la itdachyayn kammeh.

Davar acher ragle chasidav yishmor, beshaata debar nash rachim leh lekudesha berich hu. kudesha berich hu rachim leh bechol ma deihu avid venatir archoy kema deat amer (Tehillim 121:8) Adonai yishmar tzetcha uvoecha meatta vead olam.
Ta chaze, kamma chavivuteh deavraham legabbe kudesha berich hu, debchol atar dehava azil la hava chayis al dileh kelum,
224: Ela begin leitdabbeka beh bekudesha berich hu, uvegin kach ragle chasidav yishmor. veda hi itteteh, dichtiv vaavimelech lo karav eleha. uchetiv ki al ken lo netatticha lingoa eleha.

Befaro ma ketiv, (Bereshit 12:17) vaynagga Adonai et paro vegomer al devar. ihi amra vekudesha berich hu hava mache, uvegin kach ragle chasidav yishmor. ureshaim bachoshech yiddammu, illen paro veavimelech, dekudesha berich hu avad behu dinin belelya. ki lo bechoach yigbar ish. man ish, da avraham, dichtiv veatta hashev eshet haish vegomer:

VaAdonai pakad et sara kaasher amar vegomer. rabbi chiyyay patach veamar (Zecharya 3:1) vayyareni et yehoshua hakkohen haggadol omed lifne malach Adonai vehassatan omed al yemino lesitno. hay kera it leistakkala beh. vayyareni et yehoshua hakkohen haggadol da yehoshua ben yehotzadak. omed lifne malach Adonai, man malach Adonai. da atar tzerora (sefer acher denishmatin detzaddikayya tzeriran) denishmateh detzaddik tzerira beh, vechol innun nishmatin detzaddikaya kayymin tamman, veda hu malach Adonai.

Vehassatan omed al yemino lesitno. da yetzer hara deihu meshotet veazil bealma lenatla nishmatin uleappaka ruchin ulemiste lon livriyyayta leela vetatta. veda hu beshaata deatil leh nevuchadnetztzar leesha im innun nevie hashsheker, vehay hava mastin leela begin deyittokad immehon.

Dehachi hu archoy delav ihu mekatreg ella bezimna desakkana uvezimna detzaara sharya bealma, veit leh reshu lemiste ulemebad dina afillu bela dina kema deat amer, (Mishlei 13:23-24) veyesh nispa belo mishpat. mahu lesitno, dehava amar o kulhu yishtezvun o kulhu yittokdun. deha beshaata deityeyhiv reshuta limchabbela lechabbala la ishteziv zakkaa min chayyayvaya,

Uvegin kach beshaata dedina sharyay bemata bae bar nash learka ad la itpas tamman, deha mechabbela kevan deshare hachi name avid lezakkaa kechayyayva. vechol shekken dehavu telatehon kechad. vehava tava deyittokdun kulhu o yishtezvun kulhu. begin dechad itavid

VaAdonai pakad et sara kaasher amar. rabbi yochanan patach behay kera (Shir HaShirim 7:6) roshech alayich kakkarmel vedallat roshech kaargaman melech asur barhatim. asa kudesha berich hu shiltonim lemala veshiltonim lemata. keshennoten kudesha berich hu maala lassarim shel mala notlim maala hammelachim shel mata. natan maala lesaro shel bavel, natal maala nevuchadnetztzar harasha dichtiv beh (Daniel 2:38) ant hu resha di dahava, vhayu kol haolam meshuebadim tachat yado uveno uven beno, hada hu dichtiv roshech alayich kakkarmel, zehu nevuchadnetztzar, hada hu dichtiv, (Daniel 4:9) techotohi tatlel chevat bara. vedallat roshech kaargaman, zehu belshatztzar deamar (Daniel Adonai:7) argevavna yilbash. melech asur barhatim, zehu evil merodach shehaya asur ad shemmet aviv nevuchadnetztzar umalach tachtav.

Amar rabbi yehuda lemay ata hay taam beshir hashshirim. ella amar rabbi yehudda shiva devarim nivreu kodem shennivra haolam, veellu hen vechulei, kisse hakkavod shenneemar (Tehillim 93:2) nachon kisacha meaz meolam atta uchetiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:12) kisse chavod marom merishon. shehu haya rosh hannikdam lakkol, venatal hakkadosh baruch hu et hanneshama hatehora mikkisse hakkavod lihyot meira lagguf, hada hu dichtiv roshech alayich kakkarmel, zehu kisse hakkavod shehu rosh al hakkol. vedallat roshech kaargaman, zo hi hanneshama hannitelet mimmennu. melech asur barhatim, zehu hagguf shehu asur bakkever vechala beafar velo nishar mimmennu ella kimlo tarvad rekev. umimmennu yibbane kol hagguf. uchesheppoked hakkadosh baruch hu et hagguf hu omer laaretz shettaflit oto lachutz dichtiv (Yeshayahu 26:19) vertz refaim tappil.
Amar rabbi yochanan hammetim shebbaeretz hem chayyim techilla hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) yichyu metecha, nevelati yekumun ellu shebbechutztza laaretz. hakitztzu vrannenu
225: Nisa la itavid palgu nisa ufalgu dina, ella kolla kechada, o nisa o dina.

Amar lo rabbi yose, vela, veha bezimna devaka kudesha berich hu yamma leyisrael hava kara yamma leillen veazlin beyabbeshta, umayyay havu tavin missitra ochora vetavin leillen umetin, veishtechach nisa hacha vedina hacha kolla kechada.

Amar leh veda hu dekashya kammeh, dechad kudesha berich hu avid dina venisa kechada, lav beatar chad vela beveta chada (deishtechach kolla kachada), vei itavid kashya kammeh, deha leela la itavid kolla ella bishlimu kechada o nisa o dina beatar chad vela befalgu.

Vegin kach la avid kudesha berich hu dina bechayyayvaya ad deishtallimu bechovayyhu hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 15:16) ki lo shalem avon haemori ad henna. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 27:8) besasa beshalchah terivenna. veal da hava astin leh lihoshua deyittokad behu, ad deamar leh (Zecharya 3:2) yigar Adonai becha hassatan. man amar leh, da malach Adonai (veittemar vayyomer Adonai el hassatan).

Vei tema vayyomer Adonai el hassatan yigar Adonai becha vegomer. ta chaze, hachi name lemoshe bassene dichtiv, (Shemot 3:2) vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat esh. uchetiv vayyar Adonai ki sar lirot. lezimnin malach Adonai ulezimnin malach ulezimnin Adonai. uvegin kach amar leh yigar Adonai becha hassatan velo amar hinneni goer becha.

Ta chaze, kegoona da beyoma deishtechach dina bealma, vekudesha berich hu yativ al kurseyay dedina, keden ishtechach hay satan deaste leela vetatta, veishtechach ihu lechabbala alma velittol nishmatin.

Rabbi shimon hava yativ velae beorayyta, vehava mishtaddel behay kera (Devarim 21:4) velakchu zi kene hair hahi eglat bakar vegomer vearfu sham et haegla bannachal. vedina ihu bekufitz learpa lah. amar leh rabbi elazar hay lemay itzterich.
Bacha rabbi shimon, veamar, vavy lealma deitmeshach batar da. deha min hahu yoma dehahu chivya

Shochne afar, ellu hammetim shebbammidbar. deamar rabbi yochanan lamma met moshe bechutztza laaretz. lehareot lechol bae olam, keshem sheatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachayot lemoshe kach atid lehachayot ledoro (lamma) shehem kibbelu hattora. (deamar rabbi yochanan) vealehem neemar (Yirmeyahu 2:2) zacharti lach chesed neurayich ahavat kelulotayich lechtech acharay bammidbar beeretz lo zerua.

Davar acher hakitztzu vrannenu shochni afar, ellu hem haavot. vehammetim bechutztza laaretz yibbane gufam umitgalgelim tachat haaretz ad eretz yisrael vsham yekabbelu nishmatam velo bechutztza laaretz, hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 37:12) lachen hinnave veamarta alehem hinne anochi poteach et kivrotechem vehaaleti etchem mikkivrotechem ammi veheveti etchem el admat yisrael. ma ketiv acharav vnatatti ruchi vachem vichyitem.

Rabbi pinchas amar hanneshama nitla mikkisse hakkavod shehu harosh kidkaamar (Shir HaShirim 7:6) roshech alayich kakkarmel. vedallat roshech kaargaman zo hi hanneshama shehi dalat harosh. melech asur barhatim, hu hagguf shehu asur bakvarim. zehu hagguf vezehu sara vezehu melech. vekudesha berich hu pokdah lammoed asher dibber elav hada hu dichtiv vaAdonai pakad et sara kaasher amar. poked et hagguf lazzeman hayyadua shebbo yfkod hatztzaddikim.

Amar rabbi pinchas atid hakkadosh baruch hu leyappot leguf hatztzaddikim leatid lavo keyofi shel adam harishon keshennichnas laggan eden, shenneemar (Yeshayahu 58:11) venachacha Adonai tamid vegomer vehayita kegan rav. amar ravi levi hanneshama beodah bemaalatah nizonet beor shel mala umitlabbeshet bo, ucheshettikkanes (vaneshaterash) laguf leatid lavo beoto haor mammash tikkanes, veazay hagguf yair kezohar harakia hada hu dichtiv, (Daniel 12:3) vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia, veyassigu beni adam dea shelema shenneemar (Yeshayahu 11:9) ki mala haaretz dea et Adonai. mena lan ha, mimma dichtiv venachacha Adonai tamid vehisbia betztzachatztzachot nafshecha. ze or shel
226: Bisha deitpatta beh adam shalit al adam veshallit al bene alma, ihu kaim lemiste alma vealma la yachil lenafka meansheh ad deyete malka meshicha veyokim kudesha berich hu lidmiche afra dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavt lanetzach vegomer uchetiv, (Zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz. veihu kaim al alma da lemital nishmatin dechol bene nasha.

Veta chaze ha ketiv (Devarim 21:1) ki yimmatze chalal vegomer ta chaze, kol bene alma al yede malach hammavt nafka nishmatayyhu. i tema debar nash da al yeda dehahu malach hammavet nafak nishmateh, lav hachi. ella man dekatil leh, appik nishmateh ad la mata zimneh leshaltaa beh hahu malach hammavet.

Uvegin kach velaaretz lo yechuppar vegomer velaaretz dilan. vela day lon dekaim ihu lemiste alma lemaggana ulekatrega tadir chol shekken degazlin mineh ma deit leh lenatla. vekudesha berich hu chayis al benoy, uvegin kach karevin al hay egla, begin letakkana immeh ma deitnetil hahi nishmata debar nash minneh, vela yishtechach mekatrega al (davar acher 33 kerivin behay) alma.

Veraza illaa taninan hacha: shor para, egel egla, kulhu beraza illaa ishtechachu, uvegin kach beda metakkenin leh, veda hu dichtiv, (Devarim 21) yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze vegomer lo shafchu vela garimna mitateh, uveda la ishtechach mekatrega alayyhu, uvecholla yahiv kudesha berich eta lealma.

Ta chaze, kegoona da beyom rosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim dedina ishtechach bealma, ihu kaim lekatrega veyisrael bayayn leitara beshofar, uleatara kol dechalil beesha umaya verucha veitavidu chad, uleashmaa hahu kol miggo shofar.
Vehahu kol salka ad atar decharseya dedina yatva uvatash bah vesalka. kevan demata hay kol mittatta, kol deyaakov ittakkan leela, vekudesha berich hu

Mala. veatztzemotecha yachlitz ze pekidat hagguf. vehayita kegan rav uchemotztza mayim asher lo yechazvu memav. zehu daat habbore yitbarach, veazay yedu habberiyyot shehanneshama hannichneset bahem shehi nishmat hachayyim nishmat hattaanugim shehi kibbela taanugim millemala umeadennet lagguf vehakkol temehim bah vomrim (Shir HaShirim 7:7) ma yafit uma naamt ahava battaanugim. zo hi hanneshama leatid lavo.

Amar rabbi yehuda ta chaze, shekkach hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 7:7) melech asur barhatim. uchetiv batreh ma yafit uma naamt. veamar rabbi yehuda beoto zeman atid hakkadosh baruch hu lesammeach olamo velismoach bivriyyotav shenneemar (Tehillim 104:31) yismach Adonai bemaasav. veazay yihye sechok baolam ma sheen achshav, dichtiv, (Tehillim 126:2) az yimmale sechok pinu vegomer. hada hu dichtiv vattomer sara tzechok asa li elohim. sheazay atidim bene adam lomar shira shehu et sechok. rabbi abba amar hayyom sheyyismach hakkadosh baruch hu im beriyyotav lo hayta simcha kemotah miyyom shennivra haolam, vehatztzaddikim hannisharim birushalayim lo yashuvu od leafram dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) vhaya hannishar betztziyyon vehannotar biyrushalami kadosh yeamar lo. hannotar betztziyyon uviyrushalami dayyka.

Amar rabbi acha im ken zeirin innun, ella kol innun deishtearu beara kaddisha deyisrael dina dilhon kiyrushalami uchetztziyyon lechol davar. melammed dechol eretz yisrael bichlal yerushalami hi, mimmashma dichtiv, (Vayikra 19:23) vchi tavou el haaretz hakkol bichlal.

Rabbi yehuda berabbi elazar shaal lerabbi chizkiyya, amar lo metim sheatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachayotam, lamma la yahiv nishmathon beatar deitkevaru tamman veyetun leachayay beara deyisrael. amar lo nishba hakkadosh baruch hu livnot yerushalami veshello tehares leolamim, deamar rabbi yirmeya atid hakkadosh baruch hu lechadesh olamo velivnot yerushalami ulehoridah benuya millemala (sefer acher benin) begin shello yihares, venishba shelo tigle od keneset yisrael, venishba shello yehares binyan yerushala 40, shenneemar
227: Itar rachame, deha kegavvna deyisrael mitare letatta kol chad kalil beesha verucha umaya denafke kechada miggo shofar, hachi name itar leela shofar. vehahu kol dechalil beesha umaya verucha ittakkan, venafak da mittatta veda meela, veittakkan alma verachame ishtechachu.

Vehahu mekatrega iarbev dechashiv leshaltaa bedina ulekatrega bealma, vechame demitare rachame, keden iarbav veitteshash cheleh vela yachil lemebad midi, vekudesha berich hu dain alma berachame, dei tema dedina itavid, lav hachi, ella itchabbaru rachame bedina, vealma itdan berachame.

Ta chaze, ketiv, (Tehillim 81:4) tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chaggenu deitkasya sihara. deha keden shalta hay chivya bisha veyachil lenazka alma, vechad mitare rachame, salka sihara veitavarat mittamman, veihu itarbev vela yachil leshaltaa, veitavar dela yitkerav tamman, veal da beyom rosh hashshana bae learbeva leh keman deitar mishshenateh vela yeda kelum.

Beyom hakkippurim bae lenayycha ulemebad leh nayycha derucha besair dekarevin leh, ucheden ithappach sannegorya alayyhu deyisrael, aval beyoma derosh hashshana itarbav dela yeda vela yachil lemebad kelum. chame itaruta derachame salkin mittatta, verachame milleela vesihara salka benayyhu. keden itarbav vela yeda kelum vela yachil leshaltaa.

Vekudesha berich hu dan lehu leyisrael berachame, vechayis alayyhu veishtechach lehu zimna kol innun 10 yomin deven rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim lekabbela kol innun detayyvin kammeh ulechappara lon mechovayyhu vesalik lon leyoma dechippure.
Veal da becholla kudesha berich hu pakkid lon leyisrael lemebad ovada begin dela yishlot alayyhu man dela itzterich, vela yishlot alayyhu dina, vihon kulhon zakkain beara

(Yeshayahu 62:4) lo yiamer lach od azuva uleartztzech lo yeamer od shemama. uvechol makom sheatta motztze lo lo, hi shevua, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:11) velo yikkaret kol basar od mimme hammabbul vlo yihye od mabbul vegomer uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 54:9) asher nishbati meavor me noach. mikkan shello lo, shevua. umin lav atta shomea hen. veatid hakkadosh baruch hu lekayyem olamo kiyyum shello tigle keneset yisrael velo tehares binyan bet hammikdash, lefichach en mekabbelin nishmatan ella bemakom kayyaym leolamim, kede shettihye hanneshama kayyemet bagguf leolamim, vda hu dichtiv hannishar betztziyyon vhannotar biyrushalam kadosh yeamer lo vegomer.

Amar rabbi chizkiyya mehacha (mikra hu) hu kadosh yerushalam kadosh hannotar bah kadosh. hu kadosh, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 6:3) kadosh Adonai tzevaot. uchetiv, (Hoshea 11:9) bekirbech kadosh. yerushalami kadosh, dichtiv, (Kohelet 8:10) umimmakom kadosh yehallechu. hannotar bah kadosh, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) vhaya hannishar betztziyyon vehannotar biyrushalami kadosh yeamer lo. ma kadosh harishon kayyaym af hashshear kadosh kadosh kayyaym.

Amar rabbi ytztzechak may dichtiv, (Zecharya 8:4) od yeshvu zekenim uzekenot birchovot yerushalam veish mishanto beyado merov ymim. may tivuta da (kede) lemezal keden dichtiv veish mishanto beyado. ella amar rabbi yitztzechak (135 1) atidim hatztzaddikim leatid lavo lehachayot metim keelisha hannavi, dichtiv, (Melachim 2 4:29) vekach mishanti beyadcha valech. uchetiv vesamta mishanti al pene hannaar. amar leh kudesha berich hu davar sheatidim laasot hatztzaddikim leatid lavo atta rotztze achshav laasot, ma ketiv vayyasem et hammishenet al pene hannaar ven kol veen one veen kashev. aval hatztzaddikim leatid lavo ala beyadam havetacha zo, dichtiv, (Zecharya 10) veish mishanto beyado kede lehachayot bo et hammetim (45 metim otam) mehaggerim shennitgayyeyru meummot haolam dichtiv behu (Yeshayahu 65:20) ki hannaar ben
228: Kirchimu deabba al benin, vecholla beovada uvemillin talya, veha okimna millin.
Mea shana yamut vehachote ben mea shana yekulal. amar rabbi yitztzechak sofeh dikra mochiach dichtiv merov yamim.

Davar acher vattomer sara tzechok asa li elohim. ketiv, (Yeshayahu 66:10) simchu et yerushalami vegilu vah kol ohaveha sisu ittah masos kol hammitabbelim aleha. amar rabbi yehuda lo hayta simcha lifne hakkadosh baruch hu miyyom shennivra haolam, keotah simcha sheatid lismoach im hatztzaddikim leatid lavo. vechol echad veechad mare baetztzeba vomer (Yeshayahu 25:9) hinne elohenu ze kivvinu lo veyoshienu ze Adonai kivvinu lo nagila vnismecha bishuato. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 12:5) zammeru Adonai ki geut asa mudaat zot bechol haaretz.

Rabbi yochanan amar lo chazinan man deparish hay milla kedavid malka deamar (Tehillim 104:29) tastir panycha yibbahelun vegomer. mikkan sheen hakkadosh baruch hu ose raa leshum adam, ella kesheeno mashgiach bo hu kale meelav, dichtiv tastir panecha yibbahelun tosef rucham yigvaun vegomer. veachar kach (Tehillim 104:29) teshallach ruchacha yibbereun vegomer. veachar kach (Tehillim 104:31) yehi chevod Adonai leolam yismach Adonai bemaasav. veazay hassechok baolam dichtiv, (Tehillim 126:2) az yimmale sechok pinu uleshonenu rinna. hada hu dichtiv vtomer sara tzechok asa li elohim lismoach bishuato.

Rabbi chiyyay amar ta chaze, ad shehagguf omed baolam hazze hu chaser min hattashlum, leachar shehu tzaddik veholech bedarche yosher umet beyoshro, nikra sara betashlumo, higgia litchiyyayt hammetim hu sara, kede shello yomru sheacher hu shehecheya kudesha berich hu. leachar shehu chay, vesameach im hashshechina umaavir hakkadosh baruch hu hayyagon min haolam dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetztzach umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim vegomer. azay nikra yitztzechak, bishvil hatztzechok vehassimcha sheyyihye latztzaddikim leatid lavo.
Rabbi yehuda ata lehahu atar dichfar chanan, shadru leh tikrovta kol bene mata, al legabbeh rabbi abba, amar leh ematay lezil mar, amar leh efra ma deyahavu li

VaAdonai pakad et sara kaasher amar, dichtiv lammoed ashuv elecha kaet chayya ulesara ven. vetaninan pakad et sara, pekida lenukeva, zechira lidchura, uvegin kach vaAdonai pakad et sara, kaasher amar, dichtiv shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya vegomer, mehacha mashma deamar (102 2) vayyomer shov ashuv elecha, vayyomer setam, deihu hava vela shelicha ochora:

Vayyaas Adonai lesara vegomer. kevan deamar vaAdonai pakad et sara, mahu vayyaas Adonai lesara. ella hachi taninan deibba deovadoy dekudesha berich hu mehahu nahar denagid venafik meeden ihu, veihu nishmathon detzaddikayyay, veihu mazzala dechol birchan tavan vegishme birchan nazle minneh umittamman nafke, dichtiv lehashekot et haggan, deihu mazzil umashke meela letatta, begin devane (nasha) behay (181 1) mazzala talyayn vela beatar ochora. veal da ketiv vaAdonai pakad et sara pekida bilchodoy.
Vayyaas Adonai lesara. asiyyay ihu leela mehay darga (112 2) kema deittemar deha bemazzela talyay, veal da kan pekida vechan asiyyay. uvegin kach amar Adonai vaAdonai vecholla chad.

Rabbi elazar patach veamar (Tehillim 127:3) hinne nachalat Adonai banim sachar peri habbaten. hinne nachalat Adonai, achsanta leitachada baAdonai dela yitavar minah lealmin, devar nash dezache livnin behay alma zache behu lemeal lefargoda bealma deate. begin dehahu bera deshavik bar nash vezache beh bealma da, ihu yizke leh lealma deate, vezache leaala beh lenachalat Adonai. man nachalat Adonai, da eretz hachayyim. vehachi kara lah leeretz yisrael deihi eretz hachayyim.
David malka (kera leh) nachalat Adonai dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 26:19) ki gershuni hayyom mehistappeach benachalat Adonai lemor lech avod elohim acherim, uvegin kach hinne nachalat Adonai
229: Beni mata veezil, amar leh la lechush mar lehay tikrovta leorayyta hu deavdu, vela yekabbelu minnach kelum, amar leh vela mekabbele mille deorayyta, amar in. atu kol beni mata. amar leh rabbi yehuda kullehon mare metivta, amar leh, vi it man dela yaot lemetav hacha lekum velezil. kam rabbi abba veavdil minnayyhu asara di yekabbelun minnih, amar lehu yetivu bahade gavra rabba dena, vana vinnun nekabbel lemachar ventiv immeh. azlu. vinnun asara deishtaaru immeh yetivu (innun esre) vela amar kelum, amru leh i reuteh demar nekabbel appe shechinta. amar lehu vha rabbi abba let hacha, shadru bahadeh veata.

Patach veamar vaAdonai pakad et sara kaasher amar. may shinnuya hava hacha, hava leh lememar vaAdonai zachar et sara kema deamar (Bereshit 30:22) vayyizkor elohim et rachel. deen pekida ella al ma dehava bekadmita. ella bekadmita hava, dichtiv shov ashuv elecha kaet chayya, veal oto inyan neemar sheppakad achshav, mashma dichtiv kaasher amar, deilmale lo neemar kaasher amar lema zechira, aval pakad hahi milla deamar lammoed ashuv elecha.

Levatar amar hachi, hay tzaddik dezache lemesak lehahu yekar illaa, diukeneh mitpattach becharse yekorih, vchen lechol tzaddik vetztzaddik diukeneh leela kad hava letatta leavtacha lehahi nishmata kaddisha.

Vehayeynu deamar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv, (Chavakuk 3:11) shemesh yareach amad zevula, dezaharan gufa venishmata dekayymin beidra kaddisha illaa dilela kidiukena dehava kaim beara, vhahi diukena (sefer acher mizzona) mimmezonah hanaat nishmata, vhahi atida leitlabbash behay garma deishtaar beara, veara mitavar minnih vtafal tineh levara, veda hu deitkere kedusha.
Vechad kayyma diukena hahi dilela, ata bechol yarcha
Banim. man azke leh levar nash. benin. i zache behu behay alma, sachar peri habbaten, agra vechulaka tava behahi alma, behahu ibba demeoy ihu dezache bar nash behahu alma behu.

Ta chaze, hinne nachalat Adonai banim. yeruta veachsanta deibbin deovadoy dekudesha berich hu milleela ihu meilana dechayye, deha mittamman zache bar nash livnin kema deat amer, (Hoshea 14:9) mimmenni peryecha nimtza. ma ketiv, (Tehillim 127:5) ashre haggever asher mille et ashpato mehem lo yevoshu vegomer. ashre bealma den veashre bealma deate.

Lo yevoshu ki yedabberu et oyvim bashshaar. man oyvim bashshaar. illen marihon dedinin, dechad nishmata nafkat mehay alma, kamma innun marehon dedinin dezamminin kammeh, ad la yeul leducheteh bashshaar behahu tara deyeul tamman, begin demashkonin shavik behay alma uveginehon yizke behahu alma veal da lo yevoshu ki yedabberu et oyvim bashshaar.

Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose havu azle bearcha. amar leh rabbi yehuda lerabbi yose petach pumach velae beorayyta deha shechinta ishtakkechat gabbach, dechol zeman divmille deorayyta laan shechinta atya umitchabbera, vechol shekken beorcha (79 2 dishchinta kademaa veatya veazla kammayyhu divne nasha dezakkan bimhemnuta dekudesha berich hu.)

Patach rabbi yose veamar. (tehillim 127) eshtecha kegefen poriyya beyarkete vetecha banecha kishtile zetim saviv leshulchancha. eshtecha kegefen poriyya, kol zimna deitteta beyarkete veta vela nafka levar, hi tzenua veitchaze leolada benin dechashran. kegefen, ma gefen la itnata lla bezinah vela bezina ochora. kach itteta dechashra la teevad netian bevar nash ochora. ma gefen la it beh rechiva meilana ochora, uf hachi itteta dechashra hachi name.
230: Lesagda kamme malka kaddisha berich hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:23) vhaya midde chodesh bechadsho. vhu mevasser leh veamar lammoed ashuv elecha, lehahu zeman deatid leachaya metaya ad deitpakdat lehahu zimna kema deitbassar hada hu dichtiv vaAdonai pakad et sara kaasher amar. vehahu yoma dechade kudesha berich hu beovadoy hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:31) yismach Adonai bemaasav.

Amar leh rabbi abba nema lan mar al parashata levatar, amar yaot lechon lemiftach parshata da. patach veamar vayhi achar haddevarim haelle vehaelohim nissa et avraham vegomer vayyomer kach na et bincha et yechidcha asher ahavta vegomer. hacha it leistakkala hay umana deappik kaspa mimkora deara, may avad. bekadmita meayyil leh benur dalik ad denafik minnih kol zuhama deara, veha ishtaarat kaspa aval la chaspa shelemata, levatar may avid, meayyil leh benura kidvekadmita umappik minneh setayyfe kema deat amer, (Mishlei 25:4) hago sigim mikkasef vegomer ucheden hu kaspa shelemata bela irbuveya.
Kach hakkadosh baruch hu meayyil hay gufa techot ara ad demitrekav kuleh venafik minneh kol zuhama bisha, vishtaar hahu tarvavd rekev veitbene gufa minnih, vead kean hu gufa la shelim.

Levatar hahu yoma rabba dichtiv, (Zecharya 14:7) vhaya yom echad hu yivvada laAdonai lo yom velo layla, mittammeran kullehu beafra kidvekadmita min kodam dechilu vtakkifu dekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 2:19) uvau bimarot tzurim uvimchillot afar mippene pachad Adonai umehadar geono vegomer. venafik nishmatayyhu umitakkel hahu tarvavd rekev vishtaar guppa deitbene tamman (nusach acher nehora) dileh kinhora deshimsha uchezahara dirkia dichtiv, (Daniel 12:3) vhammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia vegomer. ucheden kaspa shelim, gufa shelema bela irbuveya achranayta. (mikkan ad sof midrash hannelam baddaf 118 eno nimtza 12 rak 109)
Banecha kishtile zetim. ma zetim la nafle tarpayyhu kol yome shatta vechullehu keshurin (nusach acher baseyrey) tadir, uf hachi banecha kishtile zetim saviv leshulchanecha.

Ma ketiv batreh hinne chi chen yevorach gaver yere Adonai. may hinne chi chen yevorach gaver. hinne chen mibbae leh. ella leasgaa milla ochora deolifna da minnah, dechol zimna dishchinta hava tzenia beatrah kedka chaze lah kivyachol banecha kishtile zetim illen yisrael kad sharan beara. saviv leshulchancha. deachle veshatan ukerevin karbanin vechadan kamme kudesha berich hu, umitbarchan illain vetattain beginayyhu.

Levatar dishchinta nafkat, itgalu yisrael meal petora deavuhon vehavu bene ammamaya vetzavvchin kol yoma velet deashgach behu bar kudesha berich hu dichtiv (Vayikra 26:44) veaf gam zot bihyotam beeretz oyvehem vegomer. vechaminan kamma kaddishin illain mitu bigzerin takkifin, vechol da begin onasha deorayyta dela kiyymu yisrael kad havu sharan beara kaddisha.

Chame ma ketiv, (Devarim 28:47) tachat asher lo avadta et Adonai elohecha besimcha uvetuv levav merov kol. hay kera ihu raza, tachat asher lo avadta besimcha, bizman dechohane havu kerevin karbanin vaalavavn veda hi besimcha. uvetuv levav, illen levae. merov kol, ellu yisrael dehavu emtzaiyyim benayyhu venatle birchan mikkol sitrin.

Dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 9:2) hirbita haggoy lo higdalta hassimcha. illen kahane. samchu lefanecha kesimchat bakkatzir, ellu yisrael dekudesha berich hu barich lon ibbura dechakla veyahave maasra mikkolla. kaasher yagilu bechallekam shalal. illen levae denatla maasra miggo idra.

Davar acher hirbita haggoy. illen yisrael dimhemnuta dekudesha berich hu alayyhu kedka chaze. lo higdalta hassimcha, da ihu darga resha illaa deavraham deitdabbak bah, deihu gadol vechedva beh ishtakkach.
231: Gufa denahir yirme kudesha berich hu milleela dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) ki tal orot tallecha. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 22:17) hinne Adonai metaltelcha vegomer. ucheden yitkerun kaddishin illain dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) kadosh yeamer lo. veda hu deitkere techiyyayt hammetim devatrayyta, veda hu (kaspa shelim gufa shelema) (nusach acher naseyvenaa) batrayyta vela yitamun od taama demota dichtiv bi nishbati neum Adonai ki yan asher asita vegomer ki barech avarechcha vegomer. uvehahu zimna matztzelu tzaddikayyay dela yitnassun beda ytir.

Ma ketiv vayyissa avraham et enav vayyar vehinne ayil vegomer. illen shear chayyayve alma deitkerun elim kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 60:7) ele nevayot yeshartunech umetargeminan ravreve nevayot. achar neechaz bassevach vegomer kema deat amer, (Tehillim 75:11) vechol karne reshaim agaddea. (vayyishlach avraham vego) vayyilech avraham vayyikkach et haayil vegomer. deinnun mezumanin leitnassaa bechol nisyona bisha, veyishtaarun hatztzaddikim lealma deate kemalachin illain kaddishin leyachada shemeh, uvegin kach ketiv, (Zecharya 14:9) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad vegomer.

Amar leh (nusach acher amar lon) rabbi yehuda mikkan ulehala atztzelachu pitcha. al yoma ochora alu kammeh kol beni mata, amru leh lema lan mar millayay deorayyta befarshata dekarenan bah yoma deshabbatta vaAdonai pakad et sara. kam bene ammude, patach veamar vaAdonai pakad et sara vegomer. shalosh maftechot beyado shel hakkadosh baruch hu velo mesaram lo beyad malach velo beyad saraf. mafteach shel chayya veshel geshamim veshel techiyyayt hammetim. ba eliyyahu venatal hashshenayim shel geshamim veshel techiyyayt hammetim. veamar rabbi yochanan lo nimsar beyad eliyyahu ella achat. deamar rabbi yochanan keshebbikkesh eliyyahu lehachayot ben hatztzarfit amar leh kudesha berich hu, la yaot lach lemesav bidach shete maftechot, ella ten li mafteach haggeshamim utechayye hammet. vhayeynu dichtiv, (Melachim 1 18:1) lech herae el achav vegomer veettena matar. lo amar vten matar ella veettena.

Beshaata desalkin leitdabbeka bach. kesimchat bakkatzir, da keneset yisrael desimchat bakkatzir dileh hava. kaasher yagilu bechallekam shalal. kaasher yagilu, illen shear chelin uretichin letatta bezimna dimchalleke shalal vetarfe tarfa bereshita decholla.

Rabbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 119:126) et laasot laAdonai heferu toratecha. et laasot laAdonai mahu. ella ha ukemuha. aval et, da keneset yisrael deikre et. kema deat amer, (Vayikra 16:2) veal yavo vechol et el hakkodesh. may veal yavo vechol et. kema deat amer, (Mishlei 7:Adonai) lishmarcha meishsha zara. veda hu (Vayikra 10:1) vayyak1royvu lifne Adonai esh zara vegomer. may tama et. begin deit lah et uzeman lecholla lekarva leitnahara leitchabbera kedka yeut. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 69:14) vaani tefillati lecha Adonai et ratzon.

Laasot laAdonai kema dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 8:13) vayyaas david shem. dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta keilu avid vetakken hay et lechabbera lah bekudesha berich hu. vechol kach lamma begin deheferu toratecha, deilu lo heferu toratecha la ishtakkach piruda dekudesha berich hu miyyisrael lealmin.
Amar rabbi yose kegavvevna da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 60:22) ani Adonai beittah achishenna. mahu beittah. beet Adonai. detakum meafra keden achishenna.
Amar rabbi yose veim kol da yoma chad neelamti dumiyya, begin deistallak vav min hei, vekol la ishtakkach, keden dibbur itallam.
Uvegin kach hi shechivat beafra kol hahu yoma (dena) deh. uman ihu elef chamishshaa, veaf al gav deakdimat begaluta ad la yeul hahu elef chamishshaa raza deh,
Vechad yete elef shetitaa deihu raza
232: Leh. in. lekayyem pi shenayim berucho shel eliyyhu, ella shelashtam lo mesaram hakkadosh baruch hu beyad shaliach, deamar rabbi simmon bo uree kocho shel hakkadosh baruch hu, befaam achat mechayyi metim umorid sheol vayyaal, mazriach meorot umorid geshamim, matztzemiach chatztzir, medashshen yevulim, poked akarot, noten parnasot, ozer dallim, somech noflim, zokef kefufim, mehaade malchin umehakem malchin, vehakkol bizman echad uverega echad uvevat achat ma sheen shaliach leolam yachol laasoto.

Tanya amar rabbi yose kol ma sheose hakkadosh baruch hu, eno tzarich laasot ella bedibbur, dechevan deamar mimmekom kedushato yehe chach miyyad naasa. bo uree koach gevurato shel hakkadosh baruch hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 33:6) bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu. deamar rabbi yochanan (yehuda) may dichtiv, (Shemot 12:12) veavarti beeretz mitztzerayim ani velo malach vegomer.

I hachi yekara saggia hu lemitztzerae, dela dame man detafas malka leman detafas hedyota. veod en lecha uma mezuhemet bechol tumea kemo hammitztzerim dichtiv behu (Yechezkel 23:20) asher besar chamorim besaram vegomer shehem chashudim al mishkav zachur, vehem baim mecham sheasa ma sheasa leaviv vekillel oto velichnaan beno. vechi lo haya lehakkadosh baruch hu malach o shaliach leshagger laasot nekama bemitztzerayim kemo sheasa beashshur shehaya beno shel shem dichtiv, (Bereshit 10:22) uvene shem elam veashshur. vshem haya kohen gadol venitbarech shenneemar (Bereshit 9:26) baruch Adonai elohe shem. vehaya leshem haggedulla vehabberacha al echav. uchetiv bam (Yeshayahu 37:36) vayyitztze malach Adonai vayyakke bemachane ashshur. veal yede shaliach naasa, chol shekken hammitztzerim shehem mezuhamim yoter mikkol uma, vamar ani velo malach.

Ella amar rabbi yehuda mikkan lamadnu koach gevurato shel hakkadosh baruch hu umaalato shehu gavoah al hakkol. amar hakkadosh baruch hu uma zo shel mitztzerayim mezuhemet umetunefet, ven rauy leshagger malach velo saraf, davar kadosh ben reshaim arurim metunafim, ella ani
Devv, keden vav yokim leh. bezimna (Shemot 9 2) shit zimnin eser shittin nefesh, keden shelimu vav eser zimnin, vav shit zimnin eser, (17) vav salka (beeser) bey, vav nachata beHei.

Ishtelim vav go eser shit zimnin, keden havu shittin leakma meafra, uvechol shittin veshittin mehahu elef shetitaa ittakkaf hei vesalka bedargoy leittakkefa. uveshit mea shenin lishtitaa yitpattechun tare dechachmeta leela umabbue dechachmeta letatta, veyittakkan alma leoola bishviaa. kevar nash demittakkan beyoma shetitaa mechi arav shimsha leaala beshabbatta. uf hachi name. vesimanich (Bereshit 7:11) bishnat shesh meot shana lechayye noach vegomer nivkeu kol mayeynot tehom rabba.

Amar leh rabbi yose kol da arichu zimna yattir mikkema deukemuha chavrayay deihu yoma chad galuta dichneset yisrael vela yattir dichtiv, (Eicha 1:13) netanani shomema kol hayyom dava. amar leh hachi olifna meabba berazin deatvavn dishma kaddisha uveyome dishne alma uveyome divreshit vecholla raza chada ihu.

Ucheden yitchaze kashta baanana bigvavne (72 2) nehirin keitteta demitkashsheta levaalah dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:16) ureitiha lizkor berit olam veha ukemuha veshappir hu. ureitiha, bigvavnin nehirin kedka yeut.

Ucheden lizkor berit olam. man berit olam. da keneset yisrael, veyitchabbar vav beHei, veyekim lah meafra, kema deat amer vayyizkor elohim et berito. da keneset yisrael deihi berit, kema deat amer vehayta leot berit vegomer.
Kad yitar vav legabbe hei, keden atin illain yitarun bealma (236 1) uvenoy diruven zeminin deyitarun, keravin bechol alma, ucheneset yisrael yokim lah meafra veyidkar lah kudesha berich hu.
Veyishtakkach kudesha berich hu legabbah go galuta kechusheban vav shit zimnin 10 (asar). eser zimnin shit shenin, ucheden tekum veyitpakad alma lemebad nukemin, uman deihu maich yitreme.
Amar leh rabbi yose shappir kaamart begin
233: Ose ma sheen yachol laasot malach velo saraf velo shaliach. sheani omer mimmekom kedushshati yehe chach umiyyad naasa, ma sheen hammalach yachol laasoto. aval hakkadosh baruch hu, mimmekom kedushshato omer yehe chach umiyyad naasa ma shehu rotztze laasot. ulefichach lo naaset nekama zo al yede malach veshaliach, bishvil kelon hammitztzerim, uleharot gedullato shel makom shello ratztza sheyyikkansu benehem davar kadosh, veal hadderech hazze neemar ani velo malach. ani yachol laasoto velo malach.

Kayyotztze bo amar rabbi yehuda may dichtiv, (Yona 2:11) vayyomer Adonai laddag. vechamma tzaddikim vachasidim miyyisrael shello dibber immahem hakkadosh baruch hu, uva ledabber im haddag davar sheeno makkir veyodea. ella amar rabbi yehuda kevan shealta tefillato shel yona lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, mimmekom kedushshato amar bishvil sheyyaki haddag et yona el hayyabbasha. 74 laddag kemo bishvil, kelomar vayyomer Adonai bishvil haddag sheyyaki et yona el hayyabbasha. mimmekom kedushshato amar hakkadosh baruch hu, yehe chach umiyyad naasa, ma sheen shaliach yachol laasoto.

Tanya amar rabbi shimon mafteach shel chaya beyado shel hakkadosh baruch hu, hi, uveod shehi yoshevet al hammashber hakkadosh baruch hu meayyen beoto havvelad im rauy hu latztzet laolam (yotze 6) poteach daltot bitnah veyotztze, veim lav soger daltoteha umetu shenehem. i hachi lo yitztze rasha laolam. ella hachi taninan al shalosh averot nashim metot vechulei (amar rabbi shimon veha) veamar rabbi yitztzechak lamma ishsha mappelet peri vitnah. ella amar rabbi yitztzechak hakkadosh baruch hu roe oto haubbar sheeno rauy latztzet laolam umakdim lahamito bime immo shenneemar (Bereshit 6:4) hannefilim hayu baaretz bayyamim hahem. hannefilim ketiv belo yud rishona. velamma, bishvil sheachare chen bau bene haelohim el benot haadam veyaldu lahem biznut vayyirbu

Deihu go raza deatvavn. velet lan leatara chusheban vekitztzin ochoranin, deha besifra derav yeva sava ashkechan chusheban da dichtiv, (Vayikra 26:34) az tirtze haaretz. vehu raza devv dichtiv, (Vayikra 26:42) vezacharti et beriti yaakov veda hu vav kolla kechada, veal da ezkor, ulevatar vehaaretz ezkor, da keneset yisrael. tirtze. titree ara legabbe kudesha berich hu.

Aval yoma chad deamru chavrayay vadday kolla hu ganiz kamme kudesha berich hu vecholla ishtechach beraza deatvavn dishma kaddisha, deha galuta beinnun atvavn gale lon rabbi yesa hacha, vehasheta beinnun atvavn itgalleyayn vegale lon.

Amar leh ta chaze, deafillu kad itpakkeda sara, mehay darga la pakkid lah, ella beraza devv, dichtiv vaAdonai pakad et sara vegomer. begin decholla beraza devv ihu, uveha kalil kolla, uveh itgalleya kolla, begin dechol milla deihi setima ihi galle kol satim. vela ate man deihu beitgalleya vigalle ma deihu satim.

Amar rabbi yose kamma it lan leitmashshecha go galuta ad hahu zimna, vecholla tale leh kudesha berich hu kad yetuvun bityuveta. i yizku vei la yizku, kema deitmmar behay kera dichtiv ani Adonai beittah achishenna. zachu achishenna lo zachu beittah.

Azlu, ad dehavu azle, amar rabbi yose adkarna hasheta deha beatar da yativna yoma chad im abba, veamar li beri zammin ant kad matun yomach leshittin shenin leashkacha behay atar sima dechachmeta illaa, veha zachina leinnun yomin vela ashkachna, vela yedana i hanne millin dekaamaran o hahi chachmeta deihu amar.
Veamar li kad yimtun kulefin denura go tehire yedach itavid minach. amina leh abba bamme yedat. amar li behanne teren tzipporin deaavaru al reshach yedana.
Addehachi itperash rabbi yose veal go mearta
234: Hemma haggibborim asher meolam. sheen gibbor ufaritz varitz kemo hammamzir. anshe hashshem, shehakkol yakkiru likroto hashshem hayyadua mamzir, dechevan sheroim maasav shehu paritz vearitz vegibbor hakkol yikreuhu oto shem. uma deamar rabbi shimon hakkadosh baruch hu meayyen beoto havvelad. en lecha rasha baolam meotam harshaim hayyotztzeim laolam sheen hakkadosh baruch hu meayyen bo vroe im oto hagguf yanniach ben tzaddik vechasher, o sheyyatztzil leadam miyyisrael mimmita meshunna, o sheyyaase tova achat, uvishvil kach hakkadosh baruch hu motztzio laolam.

Beyomoy derabbi yose havu innun peritztze dehavu meshaddede beturayyay im peritztze ummot haolam, vechad mashkeche bar nash vetafse leh lekatleh, havu amrin leh ma shemach, i hava yuday havu azlin immeh umafkin leh min turayyay, vei hava bar nash acharina katle leh. (veha) vhava amar rabbi yose itchazun innun bechol hay lemeal lealma deate.

Tanu rabbanan 3 devarim hallalu enan bain laolam ella bekolot, kol chayya dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:16) beetztzev teldi banim uchetiv, (Bereshit 30:22) vayyishma eleha elohim. kol geshamim dichtiv, (Tehillim 29:3) kol Adonai al hammayim uchetiv, (Melachim 1 18:41) ki kol hamon haggashem. kol techiyyayt hammetim dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:3) kol kore bammidbar. may bae hacha kala bemadbera. ella amar rabbi zerika illen innun kalayay leatara mete midbar, umikkan dehu haddin lechol haolam. amar rabbi yochanan ha tenan keshennichnas adam lakkever nichnas bekolot. kesheyyakumu bitchiyyayt hammetim eno din sheyyakumu bekole kolot.

Amar rabbi yakov atida bat kol lihyot mitpotztzetztzet bevatte kevarot veomeret (Yeshayahu 26:19) hakitztzu vrannenu shochni afar, vaatidim lichyot betal shel or gadol shel mala dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) ki tal orot tallecha veeretz refaim tappil. 231, (ad kan midrash hannelam).
Chada veashkach sifra chad dehava naitz go nukeva detinnara bisyayfe mearta, nafak beh.

Kevan defatach leh chama shivin uteren gelifin deatvavn deitmesaru leadam harishon uvehu hava yada kol chachmeta deillain kaddishin vechol innun devatar rechaya demitgalgelan batar parucheta go tehirin illain vechol innun millin dezamminin lemete lealma, ad yoma deyekum anana devistar maarav veyachshich alma.

Kara lerabbi yehuda vesharu lemile behahu sifra, la sefiku lemile tere o telata sitrin deinnun atvavn ad dehavu mistakkelin behahi chachma illaa, kevan dematu lemile bistiru desifra umishtau da im da, nafak sheviva deesha veilula derucha uvatash bidehon veitavid minnayyhu. bacha rabbi yose veamar dilma chas veshalom chova ihu gabban o delav anan zakkin leminda leh.

Kad atun legabbe derabbi shimon ishtau leh ovada da, amar lon dilma beketz meshicha deinnun atvavn havetun mishtaddele, amru leh da la yadinan deha kolla itneshe minan. amar lon rabbi shimon let reuta dekudesha berich hu beda deyitgele kol kach lealma, vechad yehe kariv leyome meshicha afillu ravye dealma zeminin leashkacha temirin dechachmeta uleminda beh kitztzin vechushebnin, uvehahu zimna itgalleya lecholla hada hu dichtiv (Tzefanya 3:9) ki az ehpoch el ammim vegomer. mahu az. bezimna detekum keneset yisrael meafra veyokim lah kudesha berich hu keden ehpoch el ammim safa verura likro chullam beshem Adonai uleavdo shechem echad.

Ta chaze, af al gav deavraham ketiv beh vayyissa avram haloch venasoa hannegba. vechol matlanoy havu ledaroma veitkashshar beh, la salik leducheteh kedka yeut ad deityelid yitzchak, kevan deityelid yitzchak istallak leatreh veihu ishtattaf bahadeh veitkashsheru
235: Vegin kach ihu kare leh yitzchak vela ochora, begin leshattefa maya beesha, dichtiv vayyikra avraham et shem beno hannolad lo asher yalda lo sara yitzchak. man hannolad lo, esh mimmayim:

Vattere sara et ben hagar hammitzrit asher yalda leavraham metzachek. amar rabbi chiyyay, miyyoma deityelid yitzchak vehava yishmael beveta deavraham, la istallak yishmael bishma, beatar dedahava sharya sosfita la idkar kammeh, uvegin kach et ben hagar hammitzrit, gevar dela yitchaze leadkara kammeh deyitzchak.

Amar rabbi yitzchak vattere sara, beena diklana chamat leh sara, dela chamat leh beena deihu bera deavraham, ella deihu bera dehagar hammitzrit, uvegin kach vattere sara. desara chamat leh beena da velo avraham, deilu beavraham lo ketiv et ben hagar ella et beno.

Ta chaze, levatar ma ketiv vayyera haddavar meod beeni avraham al odot beno. vela ketiv al odot ben hagar hammitzrit. vegin kach vattere sara et ben hagar hammitzrit. vela chamat deihu berih deavraham.

Rabbi shimon amar hay kera tushebachta desara ihu, begin dechamat leh deka metzachek lekochavim umazzalot, amra, vadday lav bera da bera deavraham lemeevad ovadoy deavraham, ella bera dehagar hammitzrit ihu ahaddar lechulaka deimmeh, vegin kach vattomer leavraham garesh haama hazzot veet benah, ki lo yirash ben haama hazzot im beni im yitzchak.

Vechi salka datach dekanne lah sara o livrah, i hachi lo ode kudesha berich hu immah, dichtiv kol asher tomar elecha sara shema bekolah. ella begin dechamat leh bekochavim umazzalot veimmeh ulefa leh nimmuse dekochavim umazzalot, begin kach amrat sara ki lo yirash ben haama hazzot, ana yadana dela yarit lealmin chulaka dimhemnuta, vela yehe leh im beri chulaka la bealma den vela bealma deate, uvegin chach ode immah kudesha berich hu.

Vekudesha berich hu baa leafrasha bilchodoy zara kaddisha kedka yeut, divgin kach bara alma deha yisrael salik biruta dekudesha berich hu ad la yivre alma, uvegin kach nafak avraham lealma vealma mitkayyem begineh, veavraham veyitzchak (lo) kayymu vela ityayshvu beduchetayyhu ad denafak yaakov lealma.

Kevan denafak yaakov lealma itkayymu avraham veyitzchak veitkeyyaym kol alma, umittamman nafak amma kaddisha lealma, veitkeyyaym kolla kegavvna kaddisha kedka yeut, uvegin kach amar leh kudesha berich hu, kol asher tomar elecha sara shema bekolah ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara, velo beyishmael. ma ketiv levatar vattelech vatteta bemidbar beer shava.
Ketiv hacha vatteta uchetiv hatam (Yirmeyahu 10:15) hevel hemma maase tatuim. vekudesha berich hu begineh deavraham la shavik. lah velivrah.

Ta chaze, bekadmita chad azlat mikkammah desara ma ketiv ki shama Adonai el anyech. vehasheta detaat batar kochavim umazzalot af al gav dichtiv vattissa et kolah vattevcha. ma ketiv ki shama elohim el kol hannaar. vela ketiv ki shama elohim et kolech.

Baasher hu sham. ha ukemuha delav bar onasha hu legabbe be dina dilela, deha be dina diltatta anshin mittelesar shenin uleela, uve dina dilela meesrim shenin ulehala. veaf al gav dechayyayva hava, lav bar onasha ihu. veha ukemuha, veda hu dichtiv baasher hu sham.

Amar rabbi elazar i hachi man deistallak mealma ad la matun yomoy leesrin shenin, mean atar itannash, begin deha mittelesar shenin uletatta lav bar onasha ihu ela bechetoy deavoy. aval mittelesar shenin uleela mahu, amar leh kudesha berich hu chas aleh delemut zakkay (velo limot chayyayv) veyahiv leh agar tav behahu alma, vela lemut chayyayv deyitannash behahu alma veukemuha.
Amar leh i chayyayva hu vela matun yomoy
236: Leesrin shenin mahu kevan deistallak mealma bemay hu onsheh. amar leh beda itkeyyaym (Mishlei 13:23) veyesh nispa belo mishpat. dechad onasha nachit lealma ihu (dina) aara bela kavvana leela vetatta behahu mechabbela veyitannash kad la ashgachu aleh milela.

Vealeh ketiv, (Mishlei Adonai:22) avonotav yilkeduno et harasha. 401 leasgaa man dela matun yomoy leitanasha. avonotav yilkeduno (et harasha) vela be dina dilela, uvechavle chattato yittamech vela be dina diltatta. begin kach ketiv ki shama elohim el kol hannaar baasher hu sham.

Rabbi shimon patach veamar, (Vayikra 26:42) vezacharti et beriti yaakov male beVav ammay. ella bitren sitrin ihu (innun). raza dechachmeta chada. deihu raza darga dechachmeta. atar deshare beh yaakov. aval hay kera al galuta deyisrael ittemar, dechad innun go galuta, hahu zimna deyitpakdun (beh yaakov) yitpakdun beraza devv. veihu beelef shetitaa.

(Vaetchannan er 1) ufekida beraza devv shit rige ufelag idan. uvezimna deshittin shenin leibbura dedashsha beelef shetitaa yakim elah shemaya pekidu livratteh deyaakov. umehahu zimna ad diyhe lah zechira shit shenin ufalga. umehahu zimna shit shenin ochoranin veinnun shivin (utelat) uteren uppalga.

Beshittin veshit yitgele malka meshicha beara (Shemot 7 2, 9 2) degalil, vechad kochava devistar mizrach yivla sheva kochvaya mistar tzafon, veshalhova deesha uchema tehe talya birkia shittin yomin, ukeravin yitarun bealma listar tzafon, uterin malchin yippelun beinnun keravin.

Veyizdavvevgun kullehon ammemaya al beratteh deyaakov leidachyay lah (lon) mealma. veal hahu zimna ketiv (vehayta) (Yirmeyahu 30:7) veet tzara hi leyaakov umimmennah yivvashea ucheden yistayyeymun nafshin miggufa uvayayn leitchaddesha, vesimanich (kol hannefesh levet yaakov habbaa mitzrayma shivim uchetiv) (Bereshit 46:27) kol hannefesh habbaa leyaakov mitzrayma vegomer kol nefesh shishshim vashesh.

Beshivin utelat kol malche alma yitkanneshun lego karta rabbeta deromi, vekudesha berich hu yitar alayyhu esha uvarda veavne algavish veyitabbedun mealma, bar innun melachin dela yimtun letamman vihadderun leaggacha keravin ochoranin. umehahu zimna malka meshicha yitar bechol alma, veyitkanneshun immeh kamma ammin vechamma chayyaylin mikkol seyayfe alma, vechol bene yisrael yitkanneshun bechol innun atre.

Ad deishtallimu innun shenin lemea, keden vav yitchabbar beHei, ucheden (Yeshayahu 66:20) veheviu et kol achechem mikkol haggoyim mincha laAdonai vegomer. uvene yishmael (yisrael) zeminin behahu zimna leatara (alehon) im kol ammin dealma lemete al yerushalem dichtiv, (Zecharya 14:2) veasafti et kol haggoyim el yerushala 40 lamilchama vegomer. uchetiv, (Tehillim 2:2) yityatztzevu malche eretz veroznim nosdu yachad al Adonai veal meshicho. uchetiv yoshev bashshamayim yischak Adonai yilag lamo.

Levatar vav zeira yitar leitchabbara ulechaddesha nishmatin dehavu attikin begin lechadta alma kema dichtiv, (sham 104) yismach Adonai bemaasav uchetiv yehi chevod Adonai leolam leitchabbara kedka yeut. yismach Adonai bemaasav lenachata lon lealma ulemeheve kullehon beriyayn chadtin lechabbera almin kullehu kechad.

Zakkain innun kol innun deyishtaarun bealma bisyayfe elef shetitaa lemeal beshabbatta, deha keden ihu yoma chad lekudesha berich hu bilchodoy leizdavvevga kedka yeut ulemilkat nishmatin chadtin lemeheve bealma im innun deishtaaru bekadmita dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyrushalam kadosh yeamer lo kol hakkatuv lechayyim biyrushala 40:

Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle vehaelohim nissa et avraham vayyomer elav avraham vayyomer hinnini. rabbi yehuda patach veamar (tehillim ma) atta hu malki vegomer. da hu shelimu dechol dargin kechada da beda.
Tzavve yeshuot yaakov, kol innun shelichan deavde shelichuta
237: Bealma delehve kullehu missitra derachame vela lehvo missitra dedina, begin deit mare shelichan missitra derachame umissitra dedina kashya. innun shelichan deatyayn missitra derachame la avde shelichuta dedina bealma kelal.

Vei tema ha malacha deitgele leh levilam ha taninan shelicha derachame hava veithappach ledina. la. leolam la ishtanne, ella shelicha derachame hava laagana alayyhu deyisrael ulemeheve sannegorya alayyhu, ulekovleh hu dina, vechach orchoy dekudesha berich hu, kad otiv leda hahu tivu dina leda. kach ha shelicha derachame hava lehu leyisrael ulevilam ithappach ledina. vegin kach tzavve yeshuot yaakov, amar david, pakkid al alma kad yishtallechun shelichaa di lehevyan missitra derachame.

Rabbi abba amar tzavve yeshuot yaakov deinnun go galvavta veyishtakkach purekana lehon go galutehon. ta chaze, tushebchan deavahan yaakov hava, veilmale yitzchak la ata yaakov lealma, uvegin kach tzavvi yeshuot yaakov da yitzchak, dechevan deishteziv yitzchak yeshoot yaakov havu.

Vayhi achar haddevarim haelle. rabbi shimon amar ha taninan vayhi bime al tzaara ittemar, vayhi af al gav dela ketiv bime tafse detzaara it beh. vayhi achar, batar darga tattaa dechol dargin illain, uman ihu devarim, kema deat amer (Shemot 4:10) lo ish devarim anochi.

Uman hava batar darga da, vehaelohim nissa et avraham deatya yetzer hara lekatrega kamme kudesha berich hu. hacha it leistakkala vehaelohim nissa et avraham. et yitzchak mibbae leh. deha yitzchak bar telatin vesheva shenin hava veha avoy lav bar onasha dileh hava, deilmale amar yitzchak la vaena la itanash avoy aleh. may tama vehaelohim nissa et avraham vela ketiv nissa et yitzchak.

Ella et avraham vadday devae leitkelala bedina, deha avraham la hava beh dina kelal mikkadmat dena, vehasheta itkelil mayay beesha. veavraham la hava shelim ad hasheta deitattar lemebad dina uleatkana leh beatreh.

Vechol yomoy la hava shelim ad hasheta deitkelil maya beesha veesha bemaya, uvegin kach vehaelohim nissa et avraham velo et yitzchak, deazmin avraham leitkelala bedina, vechad avid da, al (133 2) esha bemaya veishtelim da im da. veda avid dina leitkelala da beda. ucheden yetzer hara ata lekatrega aleh deavraham dela ishtelim kedka yeut ad deyaavid dina beyitzchak. deyetzer hara achar haddevarim ihu veata lekatrega.

Veta chaze raza demilla, af al gav dekaamaran deavraham ketiv vela yitzchak, yitzchak name itkelil beh behay kera, raza dichtiv vehaelohim nissa et avraham. nissa leavraham la ketiv ella et avraham et dayyka veda yitzchak. deha behahi shaata bigvura tattaa sharya, kevan deitakkad veizdamman bedina al yeda deavraham kedka yeut, keden itattar beatreh bahadeh deavraham veitkelilu esha bemaya useliku leela, ucheden ishtakkach machloket kedka yeut maya beesha.

Man (eved) chama abba rachamana deitavid achzar. ella begin leishtakkacha machloket maya beesha uleitattera beatrayyhu (davar acher 33 kedka yeot), ad deata yaakov veittakkan kolla kedka yeut veitavidu telata abbahan shelemin veittakanu illae vetattae:

Vayyomer kach na et bincha. vechi heach yachil avraham deihu sava. i tema begin deyitzchak la nafik mershuteh kelal, yaot, aval kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 20:25) kach et aharon veet elazar beno ella begin leamshacha lon bemillin uleadbara lon liruta dekudesha berich hu, uf hacha kach bemillin. et bincha et yechidcha asher ahavta ha
238: Ukemuha. velech lecha el eretz hammoriyya kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 4:6) elech li el har hammor. leatkana beatra deyitchaze:

Bayyom hashshelishi vayyissa avraham et enav vayyar et hammakom merachok. bayyom hashshelishi ha ukemuha, ella kevan deittemar vayyakam vayyelech el hammakom asher amar lo haelohim may tama bayyom hashshelishi vayyar et hammakom merachok. ella begin dichtiv ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara veda hu yaakov denafak minneh vehay hu bayyom hashshelishi. vayyar et hammakom merachok kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 31:3) merachok Adonai nira li.

Vayyar et hammakom. da hu yaakov dichtiv, (Bereshit 28:11) vayyikkach meavne hammakom. istakkal avraham bayyom hashshelishi deihu darga telitaa vechama leh leyaakov dezammin lemefak minneh. merachok kema deamaran merachok vela lizman kariv.
Amar leh ribbi elazar may shevacha ihu leavraham kad istakkal vechama dezammin lemefak minnih yaakov. deha kad azil lemeekad leh leyitzchak, lav shevacha kol kach ihu dileh.

Amar leh vadday (veha) chama leh leyaakov deha mikkadmat dena yada avraham chachmeta, veistakkal hasheta bayyom hashshelishi deihu darga telitaa lemebad shelimu ucheden chama leh leyaakov dichtiv vayyar et hammakom. aval hasheta kayyma leh milla merachok begin deazil lemeekad leh leyitzchak vela baa lehareher avatreh dekudesha berich hu.

Merachok chama leh go aspaklarya dela nahara bilchodoy, uvegin kach chama leh vela itgeli kolla, deillu aspaklarya denahara hava shechiach al hay aspaklarya dela nahara itkeyyaym aleh avraham kedka yaot, aval merachok, bilchodoy hava, merachok.

May tama istallak mehay milla aspaklarya denahara begin dehay darga deyaakov hava. uvegin deyaakov ad la ityeylid la ishtakkach hasheta al hay darga. vetu begin dihach vikabbel agra. vayyar et hammakom merachok da yaakov kema deittemar merachok dela zacha beh.

(Reayay beenoy behay alma ella merachok miggo hay darga deha kad ata yaakov hacha deaf al gav deatu lehahu reayay vechama leyaakov, amar avraham vadday kudesha berich hu yada begavvna achara deitchaze, miyyad vayyiven sham avraham et hammizbeach vegomer.

Ma ketiv leella vayyomer yitzchak el avraham aviv vayyomer avi, ha ukemuha. aval may tama lo ativ leh (midde)) miyyad. ela begin deha istallak merachame deabba al bera uvegin kach ketiv hinnenni veni, hinnenni deistallaku rachame veithappach ledina:

Vayyomer avraham, vela ketiv vayyomer aviv, deha la kaim aleh keabba ella baal machloket hava beh. elohim yire lo hasse. yire lanu mibbae leh, may yire lo. ella amar leh elohim yire lo legarmeh, kad ihu yitzterich. aval hasheta beni vela imra. miyyad vayyelchu shenehem yachdav.

Ribbi shimon patach veamar (Yeshayahu 33:7) hen erelam tzaaku chutza malache shalom mar yivkayun. hen erelam illen malache illae. tzaaku behahi shaata uvau lekayyma al hahi milla dichtiv, (Bereshit 15:5) vayyotze oto hachutza. begin kach tzaaku chutza.

Malache shalom. illen innun malachin ochoranin dehavu zeminin lemehach kammeh deyaakov uvegineh deyaakov avtach lon shelimu, kudesha berich hu. dichtiv, (Bereshit 32:2) veyaakov halach ledarko vayyifgeu bo malache elohim. veillen ikrun malache shalom, kullehu bachu kad chamu leh leavraham deakid leh leyitzchak, veizdazeu illae vetattae vechullehu aleh deyitzchak:
Vayyikra elav malach Adonai vegomer, pasik tama begavvavyhu, delav avraham batraa kekadmaa. batraa

Rabbi yehuda amar itberir yitzchak veistallik biruta kamme kudesha berich hu kerecha diktoret busemin dekarvin kahanayyay kammeh, teren zimnin beyoma veishtelim karbana. deha tzaara deavraham hava beshaata deittemar leh al tishlach yadcha el hannaar veal taas lo meuma. chashiv dekarbaneh la ishtelim ulemaggana avad vesidder kolla uvena mizbeach. miyyad. vayyissa avraham et enav vayyar vehinni ayil achar vegomer

Ha taninan hu ayil deitbere ben hashshemashot hava, uven shenato haya kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 7:15) keves echad ben shenato vehachi itzterich (nusach acher veet amarta ben hashshemashot. vetu veha yitzchak lo hava bealma, ella atepakeyd vechulei) (veha yitzchak lo hava bealma) veat amart ben hashshemashot. ella itpakkad chela leizdammena hahu imra beshaata deitzterich leh leavraham. kema dechol innun millin dehavu ben hashshemashot itmanna chela leizdammena hahu milla (lehahu zimna) beshaata deitzterich leh. hachi name hay ayil deitkeriv techoteh deyitzchak.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 63:9) bechol tzaratam lo tzar umalach panav hoshiam vegomer. ta chaze, bechol tzaratam deyisrael kad izdamman lon akan, ketiv lo beAlef ukeri beVav, begin dekudesha berich hu immehon beaku. lo beAlef, atar illaa yattir, af al gav delav behahu atar rugeza veaku, lehatam leela mata akta deyisrael. lo beAlef kema deat amer, (tehillim 100) hu asanu velo anachnu. ketiv beAlef ukeri beVav.

Umalacha panav hoshiam. veha ihu imhon behahu aku, veat amart hoshiam. ella moshiam lo ketiv, ella hoshiam mikkadmat dena deihu zammin behahu aku lemisbal immehon. ta chaze, bechol zimna deyisrael innun begaluta, shechinta immehon begaluta, veha ukemuha, dichtiv (Devarim 30:3) veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha verichamcha vegomer.

Davar acher umalach panav hoshiam, da shechinta. deihi immehon begaluta veat amart deihu hoshiam. ella hachi hu vadday, deillen innun mishkenotav dekudesha berich hu begaluta, uvegin dishchinta immehon kudesha berich hu adkar lon leotava lon velafaka lon min galuta, dichtiv, (Shemot 6:Adonai) vaezkor et beriti bekadmita, ulevatar veatta hinne tzaakat bene yisrael baa elay.

Vegam raiti. leasgaa reiya ochora deihu kadmaa decholla, uchetiv, (Shemot 2:24) vayyizkor elohim et berito da shechinta. et avraham leavraham mibbae leh, ella et avraham da hu chavruta veziuuga dilah baavahan. et avraham (Bamidbar 120 1) da hu maaravit deromit. et yitzchak da hu tzefonit maaravit. veet yaakov da hu ziuuga chada, kelala chada, ziuuga shelim kedka yaot.

Kegavvna da et hashshamayim da hu kelala middat layla bayyom. veet haaretz da middat yom belayla kechada. uf hacha bechullehu et, uveyaakov veet, lemeheve kolla ziuuga chada dela mitparshin dechar venukeva lealmin. vezammin kudesha berich hu leachraza bechol alma uleashmaa kal deyema (Yeshayahu 63:8-9) vayyomer ach ammi hemma banim lo yeshakkeru vyhi lahem lemoshia. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen: (74 kan parashat vayyar)
